business_summary: f-code Inc. engages in the digital transformation and consulting business in Japan. The company offers digital marketing solutions, such as CODE marketing cloud, f-tra EFO, einclo, hachidori, KaiU, and EF. CUBE. It also offers digital marketing support business, AI and technology support business, and online school and human resource development business. f-code Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Green Earth Institute Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of carbon neutral biofuels and green chemicals in Japan and internationally. The company offers jet fuels; bioplastics used for food, feed, and cosmetic additives; and ethanol for cosmetics. Green Earth Institute Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Recovery International Co.,Ltd. offers home-visit nursing and rehabilitation in-home nursing care services in Japan. It provides home-visit nursing care for people with illness or disability patients; prevents deterioration of health conditions, recovery, and prevention; and physical, occupational therapists, and speech language hearing pathologists services to maintain and restore mental and physical functions. Recovery International Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

CaSy Co., Ltd. provides housekeeping support services in Japan. The company offers home cleaning services, such as bathroom, kitchen, and room tidying; cooking services; including homemade meals, prepared meals, and home party menu; house cleaning comprising air conditioners, range hoods, and the inside of bathtub aprons, using specialized equipment and detergents. In addition, it provides organizing and storage services; and office/corporate services, including employee benefits, mobile employee cafeterias, and office cleaning. It also operates CaSy Journal, a web media with information on housework and childcare. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Bewith, Inc. engages in the provision of contact center and BPO services in Japan. It is involved in planning and development of cloud PBX; and system design, development, and maintenance services, as well as web production and web marketing. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Bewith, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Pasona Group Inc.

Mental Health Technologies Co.,Ltd. provides mental health solution services in Japan. It operates through three segments: Mental Health Solutions Business, Medical Work Shift Business, and Other Businesses. The Mental Health Solutions Business offers cloud-based services under the Industrial Physician Cloud brand, packaging services for industrial physicians and public health nurses with mental health care solutions, including ELPIS, a proprietary cloud service for employee counselling, health management, risk assessment, and administrative support. The Medical Work Shift Business provides staffing and outsourcing services to medical institutions, focusing on the dispatch of nursing assistants and administrative staff to address labor shortages and support efficient medical operations. Other businesses include medical career support, offering recruitment and placement services for doctors, and digital marketing services, such as web development, maintenance, and marketing support for medical societies and general companies. The company is involved in the medical career support business and digital marketing business for medical societies and web marketing support services. It also offers counseling services, management, video content distribution and web services, and risk cloud service under the industrial physician cloud name. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

GiXo Ltd. provides various consulting services in Japan. The company offers data-informed, and maintenance services. It also provides DI platform, a cloud-native data infrastructure that enables continuous DI decisions. GiXo Ltd. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

FB Care Service Co.,Ltd. provides nursing care services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Welfare Equipment and The Nursing Care Business segments. The company offers paid nursing home, residential care home, group homes, small-scale multi-functional home and nursing care, day care services, home care support, and home nursing care support services. It also rents and sells welfare equipment. In addition, it engages in the home renovations and food businesses. FB Care Service Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Saku, Japan.

Fuluhashi EPO Corporation engages in the processing and recycling of wood waste in Japan. The company operates through Biomaterials, Resource recycling, and other businesses. It is involved in the processing of wood waste; sale of wood chips; recycling of construction by-products; and manufacturing, procurement, and sale of logistics equipment, and wooden pallets. It also engages in the wood biomass power generation business; environmental logistics business; and vacant house management and support business. The company was formerly known as FULUHASHI CORPORATION and changed its name to Fuluhashi Epo Corporation in April 2008. Fuluhashi Epo Corporation was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

ASNOVA Co., Ltd. engages in scaffolding sale and rental business in Japan. It is also involved in temporary toilet rental business. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Bridge Consulting Group Inc. provides business management consulting services focused on initial public offering (IPO) support in Japan. The company's consulting services comprise IPO support services, such as IPO comprehensive support, preparation of financial statement disclosure material, creation of various explanatory materials, financing, and review; risk management services, including internal control and audit support, overseas subsidiary management, IT audit, and other risk management services; and financial advisory services comprising merger and acquisition advisory, due diligence, corporate valuation, post merger integration, and others, as well as accounting and financial reporting services. It also provides human resources services, including temporary staffing; and operates Accountant.job, a working platform that provides various work styles and career support for certified accountants, as well as offers business management services to companies. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Microwave Chemical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, engineers, and licenses microwave chemical process in Japan. It operates a microwave chemical plant that develops and provides microwave solutions for green, healthcare, food, and electronics industries. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.

Sunwels Co.,Ltd. operates nursing care business centered on PD house. It operates homes for the elderly that specializes in Parkinson disease, as well as a Kaatsu training gym; provides day care, in-home care support, care plan, and home remodeling services; and operates medical specific facilities. Sunwels Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Kanazawa, Japan.

Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd. provides aerial surveying services and products in Japan and internationally. It offers geospatial survey services, including space-borne remote sensing, aerial photography, airborne and mobile LiDAR surveying, UAV aerial surveying services, etc. The company also engages in the map-making, GIS data preparation, 3D models creation and visualization, LiDAR data analysis and visualization, administration-support GIS, and mapping system and 3DViewer system development activities, as well as the provision of red relief image maps. In addition, it provides disaster management services, including erosion control, volcanic disaster prevention, and river disaster prevention consulting, as well as regional planning for disaster prevention; and environmental management services, such as biodiversity conservation, environmental assessment, forest resources management, soil contamination investigation, support for environmental rehabilitation, and renewable energy development. Further, the company offers infrastructure asset management services, including urban and regional planning; planning and designing of public facilities, such as roads, ports, bridges, rivers, and lifeline facilities; maintenance engineering services comprising investigation, diagnosis, analysis, monitoring, and reinforcement; and system and database for facility management. Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Asia Airlines Measurement Ltd and changed its name to Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd. in 1963. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Ureru Net Advertising Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the advertising business in Japan. It operates in three segments: Digital Marketing Support Business, D2C Business, and Global Information and Communications Business. The company offers online shopping support cloud services, including internet advertising consultation and design, landing page creation, application forms, smartphone and PC servers solutions, and follow-up email and SMS distribution, as well as cross-border e-commerce support and merger and acquisition support. It is also involved in the D2C businesses, such as cosmetics, sanitary products, and health and functional foods; B2B specialized communications equipment rental business; and provision of network applications that allow users to share and access media information. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

Emimen Co., Ltd. provides senior home introduction services in Japan. The company offers information about senior homes; support services for moving into senior homes and information on senior homes; senior home consulting services; and care prime community site management services. Emimen Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Value Creation Co.,Ltd. engages in the marketing DX business. The company is also involved in the real estate digital transformation business, which includes demolition window, a website that uses a reverse auction system; and cemetery closure service, provide comprehensive support for closing a grave with government offices, cemeteries, and temples, as well as provides new type of grave closing and grave relocation specialist service. Value Creation Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

Delivery Consulting Inc. provides technology solutions consulting services in Japan and internationally. The company offers data infrastructure architecture and cloud migration, IoT data architecture, and data security governance; system modernization; dashboard design, data modeling and engineering, and data application, as well as support for in-house production; intelligent automation; solution engineering; system architecture and application development; cloud strategy and migration; data strategy; AI and analytics; modernization diagnostics and in-house consulting services; and data managed services. It also provides contact center reform and AI at customer contact points to optimize the customer experience through digital utilization. In addition, the company offers Salesforce Sales Cloud; Wordsmith, a natural language generation engine; and Tableau, a BI tool. Delivery Consulting Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Future Link Network Co.,Ltd. engages in the operation of local information platform in Japan. It offers real information about the city through local information platform My Place; and works with local governments to solve local issues, as well as with private sectors to solve social issues. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Funabashi, Japan.

Livero Inc. provides cloud platforms in Japan. It offers New Lifestyle Easy NAVI for real estate companies that act as intermediaries for rental properties; Company Housing Rakutto NAVI, a cloud-based relocation support service; HAKOPLA, a moving platform service; and Moving Easy Navigation, a moving concierge that will check the amount of luggage and negotiate the price with multiple moving companies. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

ProjectHoldings, Inc. engages in the provision of digital transformation services in Japan. The company provides consulting services to develop new business and existing business transformation through digital transformation. It also offers AI consulting services for organizational support, strategy formulation support, and generative AI support. In addition, the company provides UIscope services, a usability testing service that improves UI/UX by recording the operations of test users; support for SNS operations, such as X and Instagram, website improvement, and marketing; SNS management support; and digital marketing services. Further, it offers technology services that support system development, operation and maintenance work, and software testing work; and healthcare services to corporate human resources departments. ProjectHoldings, Inc. was formerly known as ProjectCompany, Inc. and changed its name to ProjectHoldings, Inc. in December 2023. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

TRE Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the waste treatment and recycling businesses in Japan. The company operates in three segments: Waste Processing and Recycling Business, Resource Recycling Business, and Renewable Energy Business. The company engages in recycling of scrap metals, waste, automobiles, home appliances, small consumer electronics, and landfills, as well as industrial waste; renewable energy from biomass; and developing, manufacture, and sale of environmental devices, plants, and special vehicles. It is also involved in the provision of various consulting services, which include measurement certification operations, environmental measures work, hazardous waste surveys and analysis, and operations related to environmental assessment for local governments. TRE Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

long_name: People, Dreams & Technologies Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary: People, Dreams & Technologies Group Co., Ltd. engages in consultancy, service provider, and products businesses in Japan. The company provides survey, plan, design, and construction management related to bridges and special structures, roads, ITS, ports and river disaster prevention, environment, and railways; various structural analyses and experiments; commercial construction work; design related to civil engineering structures and facilities; transportation, road development, route, and urban and regional plans; and general information services, such as data management for various public facilities. It is also involved in the provision of consulting, systemization planning, design, and software development related to information processing; content development; operation and distribution services; business surveys and advisory related to PFI; consulting, planning and design related to architecture; soil and geological surveys; research and development on foundation structures and construction methods; design and construction of disaster prevention works and civil engineering works related to ground disasters; construction supervision, EPC management, fundraising consulting, O and M consulting, and asset management related to renewable energy. In addition, the company operates road and public facility; PPP; demand-responsive transportation system; health support and rental activities; and renewable energy and finance businesses. Further, it sells eco products and information system. People, Dreams & Technologies Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Japan Ecosystem Co., Ltd. engages in environmental, transportation infrastructure, and asset management businesses. It researches, develops, manufactures, and sells formulations that enhance the efficiency of wastewater purification; and designs, constructs, and maintains industrial solar power generation equipment, as well as consults, plans, designs, constructs, and maintains water circulation systems, wastewater treatment facilities, and aquariums. The company engages in processing, manufacturing and sale of fire-resistant plywood and various other plywood materials; business of total heat exchangers and air conditioning, water supply and drainage, and sanitary equipment; operation of public racing stadiums, online betting sites, and AI-based bicycle racing prediction services; design, and manufacture, sale, installation and maintenance of TZS at public racing stadiums. In addition, the company engages in structural inspection, telecommunication equipment and ETC maintenance; traffic control, and road lighting, as well as the maintenance of expressways, such as maintenance, recovery from accident or disaster, measures against snow and ice, civil engineering work, and traffic regulation. Further, the company is involved in the system maintenance business; provision of ICT solutions; and real estate brokerage, sales, leasing, and other real estate related businesses. Additionally, it engages in bicycle racing-related services. Japan Ecosystem Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Ichinomiya, Japan.

GRCS Inc. engages in security-related solutions business in Japan. The company offers Enterprise Risk MT, an ERM tool that provides company-wide risk management; Supplier Risk MT, a cloud application that streamlines external contractor management and business partner management; OneTrust, a data privacy solution; Simple R, which links the learning management and ID management systems; and Connected Risk GRC Solution Audit Module, an audit management cloud solution. It also provides CSIRT MT.mss, an integrated security risk management tool; Vulnerability TODAY, an email distribution service that collect vulnerability information; Netskope, a cloud security platform that utilizes secure access service edge; HENNGE ONE, a SaaS authentication platform that provides secure access to cloud services and single sign-on functionality; HP Sure Click Enterprise; SecureCube Access Check; Imperva App Protect; Internal Risk Intelligence; Privilege Management for Windows; RidgeBot; GOOSEC; and SOCRadar, an extended threat intelligence. In addition, the company offers enterprise risk management advanced support consulting and training, management system operation improvement, sustainability support, and robotic process automation; and security services, such as cloud security measures, security product implementation and operation support, PCI DSS compliance support solution, AI-generated security risk management support, security support, compliant security support solution, penetration testing, physical penetration testing, AI-powered service risk assessment, purple team training, ransomware incident preparedness assessment, voice fishing training, and security measures evaluation system compliance support services. The company was formerly known as NANAROQ Inc. and changed its name to GRCS Inc. in May 2018. GRCS Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Last One Mile Co.,Ltd. engages in last mile business in Japan and internationally. The company offers electricity, gas, water delivery, and internet connections. The company also offers tenant move-out and renewal support for real estate companies; outsourcing call center operations, such as reservations and inquiries; consulting on measures to deal with vacancies and improve property value, such as free internet apartments and security cameras; sales of corporate services, such as Wi-Fi for stores, business phones, multifunction printers; housing equipment EC business; hotel management contract business; and listing advertising media business. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Toshima, Japan.

Slogan Inc. provides human resource support services to various industries. It operates as a recruitment support service provider for startups and venture companies. It offers Goodfind, a carefully selected job-hunting platform for new graduates; FactLogic, a consulting job hunting service; Intern Street, a long-term intern recruitment service for students; Goodfind Career, an agent specializing in recruiting ventures and startups; and G3, a career support service for high-potential human resources up to the third year of working. The company also provides FastGrow, a business media for young innovative human resources; TeamUp, a SaaS-type HR service that approaches organizational issues after joining the company; and Metanobi, a video x experiential learning platform. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Lovable Marketing Group,inc. engages in the SNS marketing and marketing automation businesses in Japan. The company offers SNS account operation support services, which provides corporate SNS account strategy of planning and producing content tailored to the characteristics of each platform, managing posting schedules, responding to comments and direct messages, advertising operations, measuring and analyzing effectiveness, and proposing improvements; SNS marketing support tool, including comnico Marketing Suite, ATELU, and autou for streamlining and maximizing the results of social media operations; educational services, such as training programs, social media education, lectures, book publishing, and information dissemination; influencing marketing; web production; advertising management; and inbound promotion support and media services. Lovable Marketing Group,inc. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Succeed co.,ltd. provides education and human resource services in Japan. The company operates through Educational Human Resources Support Business; Welfare Human Resources Support Business; Individualized Instruction Classroom Business; Private Tutoring Business, and Unico Business segment. It introduces and dispatches personnel to cram schools, educational institutions, etc.; and personnel introduction and dispatch services to nurseries, kindergartens, after-school care facilities, nursing care facilities, etc. The company also operates Individual Tutoring Academy Succeed and Pentas Kids; provides private tutoring services to individuals; operates child development support services and after-school day care services; and artificial intelligence platform business. In addition, the company offers education-related services, including individualized instruction centers, and corporate human resource development, as well as online services. Further, it provides human resources-related services comprising introducing, dispatching, and outsourcing of personnel in education, childcare, and welfare as well as undertakes the operation of related services. Succeed co.,ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

YCP Holdings (Global) Limited engages in the provision of advisory services for multinational and local companies in Singapore. The company offers in-house solutions, such as strategic planning, implementation, and slicing various business functions and phases; and management services. It also engages in the personal care; operation of veterinary hospital and pet care; food and beverage; insurance for pets; automatic conveying altar channels; and education business. In addition, the company provides professional development services through training programme. YCP Holdings (Global) Limited was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Singapore.

CS-C.Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides software-as-a-service (SaaS) marketing support services in Japan. It operates through Local Business Digital Transformation, Physical Stores, and Others segments. The company offers C-mo gourmet, a SaaS-based integrated marketing tool for restaurants; C-mo Pro gourmet, a consulting and outsourcing service for restaurants; C-mo Pro cast, a SNS marketing support service for restaurants; C-mo beauty, a SaaS-based integrated marketing tool for beauty and treatment clinics; C-mo Pro beauty, a consulting and outsourcing service for beauty and treatment clinics; C-mo, a BPaaS solution for restaurants, beauty and treatment clinics, and inns and hotels; C-mo Pro travel, a consulting and outsourcing service for inns and hotels; C-mo Pro cast, a SNS marketing support service; and C-mo Pro dental, a consulting and outsourcing service for clinics. It also engages in the management of restaurants; provision of JAPAN FOOD GUIDE, a restaurant and dining experience reservation service for inbound tourists; restaurant subleasing; and agency commission services. The company serves the food, beauty, and accommodation industries. CS-C.Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Silver Life Co., Ltd., a franchise management company, provides food delivery services in Japan. It offers prepared food products to various network of franchisees; food items to senior-care facilities. The company also engages in the original equipment manufacturing and wholesale of frozen bento meals for other food preparation companies. In addition, it sells frozen bento meals through its website. Silver Life Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Puequ CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells pumps, blowers, air conditioners, and factory equipment in Japan. The company offers pressure water tank type pressurized water supply devices, plate and shell heat exchangers, stainless steel submersible mixer, ozone deodorization/cleaning/sterilization systems, integrated sump units, landscape-friendly sea wall, and sea water chiller/titanium heat exchanger, as well as products handled by water treatment equipment, such as pumps. It also provides fire and disaster prevention equipment, water tanks, elevated water tanks, air conditioning equipment, combined treatment tanks, boilers, incinerators, cooling towers, compressors, transportation equipment, valve fittings, grease traps, oil and water separators, underwater agitator, housing equipment related products, wastewater treatment equipment, ozone generators, and nitrogen and oxygen generators. In addition, the company offers equipment repair, maintenance and inspection, design, and construction services, as well as sells disaster prevention and industrial equipment. Puequ CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Fukuyama, Japan.

Yamashita Health Care Holdings,Inc. engages in the supply of medical equipment in Japan. The company offers diagnostic imaging devices, such as MRI and CT, endoscopic systems, operating tables, and surgical equipment comprising electric scalpels, orthopedic implants, various catheters, and disposable medical materials; plans, outsources, manufactures, consigns, imports, and sells implants that are embedded in the body in the field of orthopedics; and sells and maintains medical equipment, which include dialysis machines/dialysis consumables, peritoneal dialysis, lithotripsy, and stents. It also provides consulting services related to the construction of nursing care facilities, M&A, and support to medical and nursing care institutions; and develops reservation solutions for hospitals consisting of search portal sites for hospitals and clinics, online reservations, posting agency for customer satisfaction surveys, and network security systems sales. In addition, the company offers network integration and software design and development; equipment used in physical therapy and rehabilitation, as well as related consumables such as surgical gowns, gloves, and bandages; manufactures and sells medical devices, and conduct contract research on medical ultrasound, as well as the development, sales, and consulting of medical devices and peripheral devices that use ultrasound. Yamashita Health Care Holdings,Inc. was founded in 1926 and is based in Fukuoka City, Japan.
Genky DrugStores Co., Ltd. engages in the management and operation of food and drug chain stores in Japan. Genky DrugStores Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

Optimus Group Company Limited offers integrated automotive services. The company operates in five segments: Import/Export, Logistics, Services, Inspection, and Retail/Wholesale. The Import/Export segment source used cars from auto auction operators and sells them to local car dealers internationally. The Logistics segment is involved in the operating shipping business for used cars exported from Japan to overseas destinations; providing maintenance and cleaning services for used cars; handling the transportation and storage of imported car; ancillary services for new car delivery to automotive sales customers, including storage warehouses, cleaning, quarantine, customs procedures, and pre-delivery maintenance and inspections. The Inspection segment conducts pre-shipment inspections, including safety checks and quarantine inspections for soil, animals, plants, and insects. The Retails and Whole segment engages in the retail and sale of new and used automobiles. The Service segment provides auto purchase loan service and an online advertising service for general consumers used by auto dealerships, as well as involved in the operating an automotive-related data sales business. Optimus Group Company Limited was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Wagokoro Co., Ltd. engages in retail, services, and OEM businesses in Japan. The company operates stores, which offers Japanese accessories, hairpins, Japanese umbrellas, and yukatas; and sells its products through physical stores, e-commerce sites, mail order sites, and exhibition halls. It also rents Kimono; manufacture and sells silver accessories, stone bracelets, medals and pin badges, sunglasses/glasses, emblems, buckles, boxes, hats, jewelry, leather products, and chopsticks; and provides luggage storage services. In addition, the company renovates vacant houses; and operates real estate leasing and accommodation facilities. Wagokoro Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Boutiques, Inc. operates in exhibition, M&A brokerage, and recruitment support businesses in Japan. The company operates in the negotiation, transactions, and matching type exhibition business of nursing care products and equipment under CareTEX name; online exhibitions, and hybrid exhibition of IT/DX field under DXPO name; and M&A brokerage business in the areas of nursing care, hospitals and clinic, disability welfare, IT, dispensing, childcare facility, and construction. It also provides human resources recruitment consulting services to job hunters, as well as introduces new graduates and mid-career personnel; and operates job hunting information site under Jobtra Academy name. Boutiques, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Bookoff Group Holdings Limited operates secondhand book and other goods stores in Japan, Malaysia, and the United States. It operates through Domestic BookOff Business, Premium Service Business, and Overseas Business segments. The company purchases and sells books, CDs, DVDs, games, hobby items, and mobile phones through BOOKOFF, BOOKOFF PLUS, BOOKOFF Official Online Store, and Asoviva. The company also provides premium purchasing services through hugall and aidect, jewelry order and reform services through Rehello by BOOKOFF, and trading card specialty businesses through Japan TCG Center. In addition, it offers household clearing services through BOOKOFF Okatazuke Service, produces recycled plastic materials under the CD PLA brand, operates the Aoyama Book Center bookstore, and manages the Booklog book review and reading management platform. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

Gift Holdings Inc. operates and manages restaurants in Japan. The company manufactures and sells noodles, sauce, soup, gyoza dumplings, and pork slices,. It operates its restaurants under BUTAYAMA, GANSO ABURADO, GATTON, NAGAOKA SHOKUDO, SHI-TEN-NOH, Akamisoya, Tokyo Ramen Yokocho, E.A.K. Ramen, and Machida Shoten brand names. Gift Holdings Inc. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Mitsubishi Logistics Corporation provides logistics services in Japan and internationally. It operates through the Logistics and Real Estate segments. The company offers warehousing; port, harbor, international, overland, and maritime transportation; and customs clearance services. It also engages in the development, sale, and operational management of logistics information systems; manages and operates parking lots and shopping centers; and provides condominium management and maintenance services. In addition, the company involved in the design and supervision of construction work; wrapping, labeling, and storage of business of pharmaceutical product and medical devices; sales, purchases, leasing, and management of real estate, including office buildings, commercial facilities, hotels, and residences; warehouse operation and storage; distribution centers operation and processing; and operation of electronic repair centers. Further, it engages in the power generation and electricity supply business. The company was formerly known as Mitsubishi Warehouse Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsubishi Logistics Corporation in 1996. Mitsubishi Logistics Corporation was incorporated in 1887 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

MITSUI-SOKO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various logistics services in Japan and internationally. The company operates two segments, Logistics Business and Real Estate Business. The Logistics Business segment offers various logistics services, such as warehousing and cargo handling, port operations, transportation, overseas logistics, multimodal transport, air cargo transport, third-party logistics, supply chain management support, and land transportation. The Real Estate Business segment provides building rental services. It also operates container terminals that connect offshore and onshore logistics. In addition, the company offers vessel operations for managing large and heavy cargo, as well as ship agency services that oversee port entry and departure processes, the issuance of bills of lading, and cargo bookings on behalf of shipping companies. The company was formerly known as Mitsui-Soko Co., Ltd. and changed its name to MITSUI-SOKO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in October 2014. The company was incorporated in 1909 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

The Sumitomo Warehouse Co., Ltd. provides integrated logistics services in Japan and internationally. It offers logistics services, such as warehousing and merchandise processing for cargo; and transportation services, including small-lot mixed load transportation, chartered transportation, and container transportation. The company also provides document storage/trunk room services that collect and deliver documents, magnetic tapes, videotapes, fixtures, and fittings; develops internet trunk room systems for inventory management; and offers services to handle safe deposit boxes, household effects, works of art, valuables, clothing, and furs. In addition, it offers harbor transportation services comprising container terminal and conventional vessel operations; husbanding, documentation, and various other services as a shipping agent; and international logistics services, including transportation, and import and export procedure services. Further, the company provides various information systems, such as SWIFT, an integrated distribution information system; and SWAN, a logistics management system. Additionally, it develops, operates, and manages rental housing and office buildings, commercial buildings, distribution buildings, business hotels, nursing homes, and galleries; provides real estate brokerage services; operates as an indemnity insurance and air cargo agent; trucking, merchandise processing service, and import/export cargo agent; international trade fair installation and cargo handling; storage and distribution of printed matters and promotional matters and business process outsourcing services; contract development of computer software, technical staff services related to software development, contract operation, and management of computer systems; operational management of parking lots; and freight forwarding. The Sumitomo Warehouse Co., Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Shibusawa Logistics Corporation provides logistics and warehousing services in Japan and internationally. The company provides strategic logistics services, such as warehousing and distribution processing for various types of cargo; truck transportation services, including transportation, and ocean freight container transportation for customer's logistics; ocean and air import and export handling services comprising customs clearance, overland transport, and warehouse storage at departure and arrival ports and airports; document storage and trunk room storage; and moving &household goods storage. It is also involved in EC fulfillment services; customs clearance; trade/intermediary business/management/leading of real estate; packaging/indication/storage of pharmaceuticals/quasi-drugs/cosmetics and medical equipment; planning/development/sales/operation management of information systems; employment agency; and life support of non-covered long-term care insurance. The company was formerly known as The Shibusawa Warehouse Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shibusawa Logistics Corporation in January 2025. Shibusawa Logistics Corporation was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

Yamatane Corporation engages in the wholesale, import, export, and sales of foodstuffs and related products in Japan. It also provides warehousing, cargo handling, customs brokerage, port transportation, and freight forwarding services. In addition, the company designs, develops, sells, and rents computers, computer software and other information equipment; and provides contracted operation and management services for computer systems. Further, the company involved in the trading, buying, brokering, renting, managing, and selling of real estate; and buying, selling, brokerage of artworks and other items. The company was formerly known as Yamatane Sangyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yamatane Corporation in 1995. Yamatane Corporation was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Toyo Logistics Co., Ltd. engages in logistics and business in Japan. It operates through two segments: Logistics Business and Real Estate Business. It provides international logistics, such as import and export procedures, international transportation, overseas logistics, and port transportation; domestic logistics comprises logistics center operation, domestic transportation, mail order logistics, and distribution processing; and trunk room, including storage of various data media and artworks, document storage, books and book storage, document digitization services, and dissolving confidential documents. The company is also involved in regular and bonded warehousing and storage rooms; general port transportation, port loading, and unloading; ocean and coastal shipping; general cargo motor vehicle transportation, light cargo motor vehicle transportation, and port cargo handling; air cargo transportation agency activities; customs clearance; and non-life insurance and shipping agency activities. In addition, it engages in buying, selling, brokering, leasing, management, and utilization of real estate; construction design, supervision, contracting, distribution processing, etc.; software development and sale; and information processing. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. Toyo Logistics Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Toray Industries, Inc.

Sugimura Warehouse Co., Ltd. engages in the warehousing, customs clearance, port transport, freight forwarding, and real estate leasing businesses in Japan. It operates through Logistics; Real Estate; and Other segments. The company also provides storage management, transport and delivery, logistics processing, and document management, import, export, and custom clearance services, as well as logistics information systems. In addition, it rents land, buildings, parking lots, etc. Further, it operates golf center and its parking lot; and engages in electricity sales business. Sugimura Warehouse Co., Ltd. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Inui Global Logistics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides shipping, warehousing and transportation, and real estate services in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, Europe, the Middle East, North America, South America, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Ocean Shipping Business; Warehousing and Transportation Business; and Real Estate Business. The company offers dry bulk services; ship chartering; vessel operating and leasing; and transportation services for various products, such as grain, timber, cement, fertilizer, and other dry bulk cargoes. It also provides warehousing services, such as storage/cargo handling, distributive processing, and delivery; document and media storage services; and confidential documents disposal services, as well as automobile transportation and moving services. In addition, the company is involved in the facility rental business comprising leasing of homes and office properties. The company was formerly known as Inui Warehouse Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Inui Warehouse Co., Ltd. in October 2014. Inui Warehouse Co., Ltd. was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Japan Transcity Corporation engages in logistics business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the warehousing, port transportation, as well as cargo transportation by automobiles business; consigned freight forwarding and its agency; international multi modal transport and its agency; custom brokerage; and pharmaceutical products, quasi drugs, cosmetics, medical products packaging, labeling, and storage business. It also engages in the power generation and electrical supply; containers, pallets, and other transport equipment and material handling equipment trade and lease; property trade, lease, and management; civil engineering and construction design, construction, and management; sport facility management; vehicle maintenance; logistic consulting; and other related business. The company was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Yokkaichi, Japan.

Asagami Corporation provides logistics services in Japan. The company operates through Logistics Business, Real Estate Business, and Printing Business segments. It offers warehousing services, such as deposition, consulting, and customized services; harbor services, including marine transportation, container handling, and customs clearance; land transportation services; and third-party logistics services comprising logistics network design, and warehousing and transportation services. The company also provides newspaper, new year's card, and wedding card printing services; and air cargo services consisting of air cargo forwarding, customs brokerage arrangement, and packaging and crating services. In addition, it offers information technology logistics management services, such as transaction and inventory management, consolidation, continuous move management, carrier management, cargo/carrier matching systems, and data exchange with ERP/SCM software through global logistics network. Further, the company engages in leasing and management of real estate properties; and construction and contract work. Asagami Corporation company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. The company operates as a subsidiary of OA Corporation.

The Keihin Co., Ltd. provides logistics services worldwide. It primarily offers trucking; marine and harbor transportation; shipping and forwarding; air freight forwarding, express, and customs and real estate brokerage services. The company's services include warehousing/distribution center, mail-order support, and domestic cargo transport, including trucking and marine container transport; and thermal, port construction, wind power/biomass, mining development, power substation, road/bridge, and hospital/ forest preservation/water supply projects; cargo transport; export car handling; and customs clearance. It also provides domestic logistics IT systems, such as a system for providing information on inventories at warehouses, a logistics EDI system, and a cargo tracking system; and global logistics IT systems comprising a cargo track and trace, and export motor vehicle loading information system, as well as a system for providing information on import seaborne shipments. In addition, the company offers real estate, and transportation and handling equipment brokerage; and worker dispatching services. Further, it engages in the packaging, labeling, warehousing and distribution, and sale of medicines, quasi-drugs, cosmetics, wharfage business, express service, intermodal transportation, and medical equipment. The Keihin Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Maruhachi Warehouse Company, Limited operates as a logistics company in Japan. The company provides warehousing services comprising cargo storage, loading and unloading services, and warehouse rental services. It is also involved in the transportation activities that handles the delivery of the stored cargo. In addition, the company engages in real estate development, sales, brokerage, rental, management, and consultation activities. The company was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Chuo Warehouse Co.,Ltd. provides various logistics services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through segments Domestic logistics business, International cargo business, Real estate rental business. The company offers warehousing, which includes storage at a constant temperature and humidity, bonded warehouse, storage units, business support, storage of dangerous goods, distribution processing, warehouse receipts, and logistics facility rental; and transportation business offers Freight forwarding, trucking, and insurance agency. It also engages in the packaging precision machinery, three-ply cardboard, and packaging materials, and customs clearance; and leasing, brokerage, management, and sale of real estate. The company was incorporated in 1927 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

Kawanishi Warehouse Co.,Ltd. provides logistic services in Japan and internationally. It offers frozen and refrigerated warehouses, as well as normal warehouses that include constant temperature and humidity warehouses, room temperature warehouses, fumigated warehouses, and auto-rack warehouses. The company also provides transport and delivery services, including marine container, to-door, refrigerated, and consolidated cargo transport services; port transport services comprising ship's agent services, import and export procedures, and export packing services; and international logistics that include intermodal transport services, NVOCC/consolidation, and air freight handling services, as well as cargo management logistics services. In addition, it offers custom clearance, and distribution processing services, such as assortment of automobile related products, sorting work for beans, label and price tag affixing for products, and arrangement of gift sets. Further, the company provides delivery and receipt of trunk room for storage and recycling of confidential documents. Kawanishi Warehouse Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Yasuda Logistics Corporation engages in the logistics and real estate businesses in Japan. It offers logistics centers and delivery services, including warehouses and logistics centers, transport and delivery services, and supply chain solutions; medical logistics comprising pharmaceuticals, healthcare products, medical devices, reagents, and diagnostic drug logistics; IT equipment logistics services, such as IT equipment kitting, IT equipment lifecycle management, server relocation, and IT equipment maintenance and delivery services; international logistics services that include international transport network, marine transport, airport transport, logistics, and third country transport services, as well as customs clearance services; and document storage and relocation solutions consists of document storage, retrieval, and digitalization services, as well as one-stop moving services. The company is also involved in the real estate business that include office buildings, and residential leasing; redevelopment of hotel and retail facilities; operation of parking lots; and provision of building maintenance services. Yasuda Logistics Corporation was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

PHYZ Holdings Inc. provides various EC solutions for companies operating EC sites in Japan. It operates through Operation Services Business; Transport Services Business; International logistics service business; and Information system business segments. The company provides operation services, including consulting consulting services, warehouse operations management, and temporary staffing services for e-commerce site operators, manufacturers, and delivery companies. It also offers computer system development contracting and system engineer staffing services. The company was formerly known as PHYZ Inc. and changed its name to PHYZ Holdings Inc. in October 2019. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. PHYZ Holdings Inc. is a subsidiary of AZ-COM MARUWA Holdings Inc.

Kantsu HD Co.,Ltd. provides import and customs clearance, domestic logistics, order processing, and customer support services in Japan and internationally. The company offers logistics outsourcing services; in-house distribution center operation transfer services; frozen and refrigerated distribution center services; and logistics consulting services. It also provides EC automation program services; one-stop outsourcing service for order management and logistics operations; warehouse rental services; warehouse management system; checklist system; order processing automation application; and automatic packaging machines. The company was formerly known as Kantsu Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Kantsu HD Co.,Ltd. in April 2026. Kantsu HD Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

e-LogiT co.,ltd. provides logistics agency services in Japan. The company offers logistics outsourcing services; logistics consulting services; logistics system construction support services; and corporate training/employee training/lectures/classes. It serves general businesses, logistics operators, and logistics-related businesses. e-LogiT co., ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

AGEHA Inc. provides general branding support services in Japan. It also offers corporate, inner, sustainability, purpose, outer, product and service, and recruitment branding support services, as well as digital marketing support services. AGEHA Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Caster Co.Ltd. engages in the provision of human resource business management services. The company offers remote assistant, recruitment, professional accounting, specialized labor, and specialized sales marketing services. It also provides temporary staff matching services for companies; remote assistant services; and recruitment media services for remote work. Caster Co.Ltd. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Saito, Japan.

NISSO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd provides human resources solutions services in Japan. The company engages in the provision of General Human Resources Services for the manufacturing industry, including temporary staffing, manufacturing process outsourcing, and engineering personnel services, as well as administrative staffing and placement; and development of production management and equipment maintenance systems. It also operates facility and home care; develops contract and packaged software; constructs network systems; and offers consulting services and outsourcing business for various security services. In addition, the company offers manufacturing dispatch and contracting services; BPO; and home-based nursing care, as well as incidental or related operations services. NISSO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Daiei Kankyo Co., Ltd. engages in the waste management and valuable resource recycling businesses in Japan. It is involved in the waste management and recycling, soil remediation, forest management, facility construction and administration, and consulting services, as well as generates electricity through biogas and solar. The company also engages in the other waste-related businesses, including the provision of temporary staffing and recruitment services, as well as agribusiness; and sports promotion and golf course management businesses. In addition, it offers aluminum and recycled plastic pallets. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan. Daiei Kankyo Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Wingtowa Co., Ltd.

toridori Inc. provides influencer marketing platform services in Japan. The company operates toridori base, a platform service that connects influencers and companies through PR; toridori ad, a platform that specializes various influencers to post ads from registered influencer platforms; and toridori marketing, an advertising service requesting influencers to post promotional content. It also operates toridori studio that engages in the planning and video production for YouTube and other SNS-related activities; and toridori made, a service for the influencer to launch the own brands and sell products. toridori Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

ASO International, Inc. operates in dental orthodontics business in Japan. The company offers SYMPHONY, an IDB system; HARMONY, a lingual correction system; CHANGE, full jaw orthodontic treatment; SHU-lider, a 3D metal-printed orthodontic device with sliding mechanics; LuxClear, an orthodontic device with shape memory properties; Form 4B, a new generation low force display method 3D printer; HEYGEARS, a 3D printer designed specifically for dentistry; AsoAligner, a transparent, thin, and aesthetically mouthpiece shaped orthodontic device; SATT SYSTEMS, a new LCD method 3D printer; WE SCAN, an AI automatic correction function and optical engine; and ASO Digital, a 3D printing and modeling service. It also offers orthodontic device, such as study models, IDB lingual/lingual, band/wire type and resin based orthodontic device, functional appliances, retainers, and other appliances; and AILINE, a tele consultation services. In addition, the company offers customized bands and metal print HYRAX. ASO International, Inc. was founded in 1982 and is based in Chuo, Japan.

GENOVA, Inc. engages in the medical platform and smart clinic businesses in Japan. It offers Medical Doc, a platform that distributes articles for medical institutions, patient experience articles, treatment videos, and medical-related articles; and online medical treatment and consultation service, which offers medical treatment at home or work for users without going to a hospital. It also provides Smart Clinic, such as NOMOCa-Stand, a smart and simple automatic payment and reception machine; NOMOCa-Regi, a self-pay machine dedicated to the clinic; PNOMOCaAIchat, an AI chat automatic response services; and CLINIC BOT, an AI Chatbot System. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Tokyo, Japan

Sumasapo Inc. engages in the digital experience promotion business in Japan. It offers totono, a tenant app to facilitate communication between real estate management companies and tenants; operates outbound call center for tenant satisfaction survey services; and Suma Support Club, a tenant safety service which provides consultation services on security systems, and problems related to buildings and equipment, as well as rent guarantee services to management companies and owners. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

ibis inc. operates as a mobile-savvy engineering company in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It operates through Mobile, Solutions, and AI Singing Voice Synthesis segments. The company develops and operates ibisPaint, a mobile painting app; and VoiSona, an AI singing composing app. It also provides support for application development, server construction, operation and maintenance, and IT engineer dispatch services. ibis inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Axis Consulting Corporation provides human capital services in Japan. The company offers AXIS Agent, a talent database for recruitment consulting and career change support services, including full-time and part-time employment placements, as well as project introductions for consulting firms, business companies, PE and VC funds; AXIS Solutions, a skillshare support service for freelance consulting in solving management and business issues; and AXIS Advisors, a digital platform for management or operational concerns consultation. It also provides CxO-Pass, a matching service that allows startup founders to recruit CxO talents. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd. provides building management and operations services in Japan and the United States. The company also engages in security services; environmental facility management, including water supply, sewage treatment, and waste management and disposal facilities; residential management comprising managing condominiums, public housing, etc.; and real estate fund management businesses. In addition, it provides security; staffing; and payroll outsourcing and consulting services, as well as event planning and management, print design, bookbinding, and real estate finance. NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Nishinomiya, Japan.

ispace, inc., a lunar resource development company, engages in designing and building lunar landers and rovers to transport customer payloads to the moon. The company also offers payload services, including video and driving data acquisition, as well as resource harvesting systems; and cameras, communications devices, and cell cultivation devices. In addition, it provides lunar data services, such as imaging, environmental data, telemetry, and resources information to government space agencies, universities, research institutions, and private companies for information, mission planning, and lunar surface development. It operates in Japan, Europe, and the United States and Saudi Arabia. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Toyo Wharf & Warehouse Co., Ltd. provides logistics services in Japan. It offers room temperature warehouse, temperature-controlled warehouse, heated warehouse, fruit and vegetable warehouse, refrigerated and frozen warehouse, hazardous materials warehouse, warehouse with ceiling crane, silo, and open storage yard; integrated logistics services for logistics terminals and sea-land operations; provide logistics-related outsourcing services; leasing of logistics-related facilities; and on-site work in factories and similar facilities; customs clearance services. The company also provides logistics through railways. In addition, it offers ship loading and unloading, and container handling at terminals; maritime transportation, customs clearance, shipping and insurance agency, facility rental, and factory premises work services; and international logistics services through land, sea, and air, as well as storage solutions. Toyo Wharf & Warehouse Co., Ltd. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Sakurajima Futo Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the port transportation business in Japan. The company operates through Bulk Cargo; Liquid Cargo; and Logistics Warehouse segments. It is involved in the bulk cargo handling, such as coal, coke, raw and industrial salt, soda ash, fertilizer raw materials, etc.; liquid cargo handling, including petroleum fuels, chemicals, and petrochemicals, as well as raw materials for pharmaceutical manufacturing, textile materials, and food additives; and owns and operates a distribution and processing facility, a refrigerated warehouse, a low-temperature logistics center, and a chemicals center, as well as engages in solar power generation and electricity sales businesses. Sakurajima Futo Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Rinko Corporation engages in port transportation services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Transportation, Real Estate, and Hotel Business segments. The company provides harbor transportation, freight harboring, air cargo handling, warehousing, trucking business, ship mooring business, customs clearance, international maritime, collection and delivery, packaging, labeling, and storage; hotel management, wedding halls, and restaurants; and land and building rental, sales, and real estate brokerage. It also offers insurance products, industrial waste disposal business, as well as sales, repair, and maintenance of construction machinery. The company was formerly known as Niigata Shinko Development and changed its name to Rinko Corporation in 1991. Rinko Corporation was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

Suzuyo Shinwart Corporation operates as an information services and logistics solutions in Japan. The company provides system solutions, including logistics consulting, HR/payroll/attendance solution, payroll outsourcing, electronic paystub, electronic personnel reporting, electronic annual tax return, financial accounting solution, CMS (content management), digital marketing, workflow/expenses, groupware, and webmail; IT infrastructure, such as data center, bare metal server and private cloud, online storage, S-port telework and remote PC service, S-port X (cross) connect, internet connection service, monitoring/operation/security, pre-driving alcohol check and temperature measurement cloud service, business chat, monitoring and operation/security, pre-operation alcohol check and temperature check cloud service, cloud service to help improve employee engagement, salesforce related solution, web conferencing zoom, reservation system Rizaen, and virtual server (Iaas); and system development solutions comprising system construction and development, network construction, logistics system development, cloud-based inventory and warehouse management systems, and package system. It also offers S-PAYCIAL, a solution for personnel, payroll, and attendance solutions; logistics IT consulting service; S-Port; Asa; BIZ-Oin; and S-Port telework/remote PC services. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Fushiki Kairiku Unso Co.,Ltd. engages in the provision of port transportation services in Japan. It also engages in port and maritime transportation, warehousing, domestic shipping, irregular route business, shipping agency, customs brokerage, packing, industrial waste collection and transportation, air transport agency, and measurement certification businesses, as well as business related to contracting and guarantee of the security. In addition, it offers freight truck transportation, non-life insurance agency, and automobile liability insurance agency services; real estate lending; and automobile disassembly and maintenance services. Further, the company processes and sells carbon materials, hydrogen peroxide, and groceries. Further, the company engages in the investment; worker dispatch; restaurant business; and manufacture of salt. Fushiki Kairiku Unso Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Takaoka, Japan.

Hyoki Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd. provides shipping services in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments: Shipping Business, and Port transportation and Warehousing Business. The company offers domestic shipping, transport steel materials for construction, as well as various cargo, including heavy plant, bulk cargo, feed, and various raw materials; semi-liner service for the transport of individual cargo; and charter services. It also provides warehouse services; port transportation and custom clearance services, including export and import services; and international multimodal transport services. Hyoki Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is based in Kobe, Japan.

Daiun Co.,Ltd. engages in the cargo handling business in Japan. It operates in Port Transportation Business and Automobile Transportation Business segments. The company primarily offers ocean freight, harbor works, import/export customs clearance, drayage transportation, warehouse, cargo transport, and used car yard services. It also engages in the agency business for various types of non-life insurance, including automobile, fire, accident, and marine insurance. The company was formerly known as Osaka Shipping Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Daiun Co.,Ltd. in January 1962. Daiun Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kamigumi Co., Ltd. provides integrated logistics services in Japan and internationally. The company offers comprehensive logistics services, including harbor transport; warehouse storage, distribution processing, and packing services; and transport services comprising truck, air, sea freight, and rail transportation. It also provides on-site factory services, such as loading and unloading of ship-borne raw materials, secondary processing, product controls/shipping work, and environmental response work; construction and mechanical work services comprising construction, breakdown and disposal, machinery and engineering, and machinery maintenance services; and heavy cargo transportation services. In addition, the company engages in real estate, which includes apartment construction, apartment rental, development and leasing of commercial facilities, and operation of parking areas; solar business; alcoholic beverage production; restaurant business; and agribusiness. Kamigumi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1867 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Tradia Corporation operates as a logistics company. It engages in port transportation business, customs clearance business, general warehousing business, and freight forwarding business. The company also operates transportation and non-life insurance agency, as well as engages in real estate leasing and pharmaceutical manufacturing business. It transports goods between Japan, India, China, Thailand, Vietnam, and internationally. The company was formerly known as Dainichi Tsuun Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tradia Corporation in April 1994. Tradia Corporation was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Sanritsu Corporation engages in the packaging, transportation, and warehousing business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Packaging Business, Transportation Business, Warehousing Business, and Rental Building Business segments. It offers steel, wooden box, reinforced cardboard, and cardboard packing products. The company also provides truck transportation services, as well as warehouse storage, and cargo handling services. In addition, it offers bonded and customer clearance services; air and sea transport arrangement services; and rental building business. It offers services for electronic and communication devices, glass products, machine tools, and medical equipment manufacturers. Sanritsu Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Daito Koun Co.,Ltd. engages in the transportation business in Japan. The company is involved in the port transportation and shipping; forwarding; agency; warehousing; customs clearance; truck transportation; packaging; non-life insurance agency; shipping agency; industrial waste collection and transportation; air cargo transportation agency; food freezing and refrigeration; real estate rental; labor dispatch; and other business. It also engages in buying and selling and import/export business of various products; and import/export agency business for various goods. The company was formerly known as Tatsumi Shipping Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Daito Koun Co.,Ltd. in January 1961. Daito Koun Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. provides logistics, mobility, information, and staffing services in Japan, China, North America, and internationally. The company provides logistic services, such as distribution center operations, container equipment production, shipping operations, as well as warehousing and packing. It also offers vehicle management, maintenance, rental services, vehicle leasing, and insurance agency services. In addition, the company provides consulting/system development, and system maintenance. Further, it provides recruitment, temporary staffing, recruitment support services, and introduction dispatching. The company was formerly known as Kimura Unity and changed its name to Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. in November 1990. Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. was founded in 1881 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

K.R.S. Corporation provides logistics services in Japan and internationally. The company offers warehousing, freight forwarding, intermediary transport agency, motor truck transportation, and customs clearance services, as well as packing, packaging, and delivery services, etc. for bottled/canned products and other general goods. It also sells and leases vehicles and logistics-related machinery and equipment; sells industrial and automotive fuel and oil; provides logistics information and consulting on logistics operations; and sells commodity goods and food products, including fresh, preserved, and processed food products, as well as rents and leases real estate properties. In addition, the company provides automotive wrecking and maintenance services; insurance agency services; administrative, accounting, human resources, and labor management; subcontracted planning; development and construction of IT systems for the outsourced administrative and other procedures; and other related services. K.R.S. Corporation was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Chofu, Japan.

Eurasia Travel Co., Ltd. provides travel agency services in Japan and internationally. It engages in planning, arranging, and selling overseas and domestic travel; and acts as an agent for overseas travel insurance. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Azuma Shipping Co., Ltd. engages in logistics, maritime transportation, real estate, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company provides domestic and international shipping services, including domestic shipping, ocean shipping transportation, ship agency, passenger ship deployment; truck transportation, heavy and long cargo transportation, car ferry transportation; liquid transportation, project cargo and heavy construction equipment transportation, maritime container transportation, air cargo transportation, vessel chartering, and regional transportation services for CIS countries, Mongolia, China, and Thailand. The company also offers import and export related services, including customs clearance services for general and hazardous cargo, transportation and delivery services, export packaging services, terminal operation services, and Chinese shipping company collection agent services. In addition, the company provides warehouse services, including general warehouse, dangerous goods warehouse, trunk room, and main warehouse services; logistics solutions, including hazardous materials, liquid transport, environmental, and moving solutions; and real estate services. The company serves shipping, logistics, transportation, international trade, import and export, warehousing, civil engineering, construction, industrial goods, project cargo, heavy equipment, hazardous materials, liquid cargo, marine containers, and real estate sectors. The company was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

TBS Holdings,Inc. engages in the broadcasting and real estate businesses primarily in Japan. It operates through three segments: Media and Content, Lifestyle, and Real Estate and Other businesses. The Media and Content segment offers business broadcasting, program production, video technology, art production, VFX, sound technology, lighting technology, various events, video software planning and production, CS business, computer software planning and development, video and audio software production, sales and distribution, program sales, video software production and sales, anime and manga planning and production, and music software planning and production, as well as television and radio broadcasting and related businesses. The Lifestyle segment offers mail order, general merchandise retail, cosmetics manufacturing and sales, and educational businesses. The Real Estate and Other businesses segment offers maintenance and service businesses studio management, heating and cooling management, parking site management, equipment leasing, insurance agency, and real estate leasing. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Broadcasting System Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to TBS Holdings,Inc. in October 2020. TBS Holdings,Inc. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings Corporation engages in television and radio broadcasting activities in Japan and internationally. The company operates in two segments: Broadcasting and Content, and Lifestyle. The company engages in television and radio broadcasting, as well as activities related to various content. It is also involved in the operation of housing exhibition sites, at-home shopping, golf club operating activities, licensing, music publishing, and international business development. The company was formerly known as Asahi Broadcasting Corporation and changed its name to Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings Corporation in April 2018. Asahi Broadcasting Group Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

BSN Media Holdings, Inc. engages in the radio and television broadcasting business. The company operates through Broadcasting Business, Systems-Related Business, and Building Services and Other Business segments. It is involved in planning, production, and sale of broadcast programs; various events, including art, music, sports, movies, theater, entertainment, science, etc.; and planning, publishing, and sale of publications. The company also engages in IT solutions such as system integration business; and building management and real estate business. The company was formerly known as Broadcasting System of Niigata Inc. and changed its name to BSN Media Holdings, Inc. The company was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation provides satellite-based multichannel pay TV and satellite communications services primarily in Asia. The company operates through Media Business and Space Business segments. The Media Business segment offers platform services, such as customer management activities to broadcasting businesses; and delivers broadcasting services through communication satellites and fiber optic networks. The Space Business segment provides satellite communication circuits to the broadcasting businesses; and satellite communication services, including data and mobile communication services to government, public organizations, and corporations. It also plans and produces content; sells satellite connections; plans, production investment, sales, and promotion of related businesses for video content, primarily anime; operates as a telecommunications carrier and systems integrator for satellite communications and broadcasting services; streaming business; fiber-optic alliance; and offers mobile satellite communication services. In addition, the company provides earth observation satellite images; and offers technical support services. The company was formerly known as SKY Perfect JSAT Holdings Inc. and changed its name to SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation in April 2026. SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Vision Inc., together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in the provision of mobile Wi-Fi router rental services in Japan and internationally. It also offers information infrastructure and office devices, such as fixed communication and mobile communication devices, OA equipment, business phones, and website creation; and travel information and transportation services. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Smartvalue Co., Ltd. provides cloud solutions in Japan. It operates through Digital Government, Mobility Services, and Smart Venue segments. The company offers SMART L-Gov, a cloud platform for solving various regional issues; GaaS (Government as a Service), an online government platform for administrative services; Open-gov platform for smart cities and areas; and Kuruma Base, a telematic service for corporations, providing white labelled in-vehicle devices, management consoles, and smartphone apps for mobility sharing services, such as car sharing and call centers. It also provides DX consulting, which supports car-related businesses, including consulting, system implementation, and growth support; and business solutions, such as vehicle solutions for corporations. Smartvalue Co., Ltd. was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. offers entertainment services. It operates through five business segments: Content Distribution Business, Store Services Business, Communications Business, Business Systems Business, and Energy Business. It provision and sale of the video distribution service; provide, sell, and install store solutions including music distribution, as well as manage and develop music copyrights. The company provides business management services for hotels, hospitals, golf courses, etc, as well as develops, manufactures, and sells management systems and automatic payment machines. In addition, it provides electricity to stores, buildings and commercial facilities; sells high and low voltage electricity and gas; and provides green energy. The company was formerly known as USEN-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in April 2024. U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of UNO-HOLDINGS Co., Ltd.

WirelessGate, Inc. provides wireless remote services in Japan. The company provides monthly communication services, such as WiMAX terminals that can be used for internet services and wireless gate Wi-Fi services, as well as additional services, including terminal insurance.
