It also offers wireless communication services primarily through consumer electronics retailers, mobile phone stores, and e-commerce site; direct sales of eSIMs for inbound tourists; and provides various services which includes telecommunication products. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

NJ Holdings Inc. engages in the game development and mobile communication sales business in Japan. It operates through Game Business, Mobile Business, and Others segments. The Game Business segment focuses on the contract development and operation of mobile and console games. The Mobile Business segment mainly sells mobile phones to individual customers and conducts business with telecommunications carriers, including operating retail stores that handle devices and services from multiple carriers. The Others segment includes credit card settlement business. The company was formerly known as Nepro Japan Co. Ltd. and changed its name NJ Holdings Inc. in December 2015. NJ Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Forval RealStraight Inc. provides real estate brokerage and office relocation support services in Japan. It also engages in the sale of office equipment. The company was formerly known as Fread Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Forval RealStraight Inc. in July 2009. Forval RealStraight Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Forval RealStraight Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Forval Co., Ltd.

Japan Communications Inc. provides mobile communication services and mobile solutions in Japan, the United States, and internationally. It engages in the development and operation of an authentication platform for internet transactions; operation for telecommunication business; and development and research of technologies for mobile virtual network operator and mobile virtual network enabler. The company is also involved in the development of network security solutions; and the development and sale of sub-sim and related solutions, as well as offers mobile solutions. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ReYuu Japan Inc. engages in trading and distribution of reused communication terminal devices in Japan. The company retails smartphones under iPhone, Galaxy, and Xperia brands; and tablets and PCs under iPad and MacBook brands, as well as new and unused outlet goods. It also provides integrated subscription, kitting, and corporate purchasing services. In addition, the company engages in the restoration of phones; operation of an online shop and mobile refurbishment center; and rental of communication terminals and equipment for corporations. It sells its products to MVNO operators, mobile phone agencies, wholesalers, retailers, companies, and individuals through its own website and external EC malls. ReYuu Japan Inc. was formerly known as Nippon Telephone Inc. and changed its name to ReYuu Japan Inc. in February 2024. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Crops Corporation engages in the sale and service of mobile phones Japan and internationally. The company is also involved in the staffing business; building maintenance business include cleaning, equipment management, and facility security for commercial facilities and office buildings; security management; reception; store subleasing business; planning and wholesale of imported stationery, OEM, and packaging supplies; selling of natural cosmetics; and outsourced works, such as work visa application, payroll calculation, and tax and social insurance calculation. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

NTT, Inc. operates as a telecommunications company in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Comprehensive ICT Business, Regional Communications Business, Global Solutions Business, and Others segments. Its Comprehensive ICT Business segment offers mobile phone and fiber-optic broadband services; financial, content, and lifestyle services; and corporate communication services and solutions. This segment also engages in engineering, system development, and related businesses. The Regional Communications Business segment provides optical fiber services, corporate services, fixed-line telephone services, and related businesses. Its Global Solutions Business segment offers consulting, IT solutions, system and software development, and maintenance services. This segment is involved in port operations, data center operations, and related businesses. Its Others segment engages in real estate and construction, energy, and other businesses. The company was formerly known as Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation and changed its name to NTT, Inc. in July 2025. NTT, Inc. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

KDDI Corporation engages in the provision of mobile telecommunications services in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments, Personal Services and Business Services. The Personal Services segment offers 5G telecommunication services and other services, such as finance, energy, and LX through its multi-brands comprising au, UQ mobile, and povo; and entertainment services, including video to individual customers. The Business Services segment provides smartphones and other devices, network, and cloud services; and data center services to corporate customers under the TELEHOUSE brand name. It is also involved in the provision of solutions for the development and expansion of businesses through IoT, DX, generative AI, and other technology centered on 5G communications. In addition, the company sells mobile handsets. KDDI Corporation was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

SoftBank Corp., together with its subsidiaries, provides mobile communications and fixed-line telecommunications and ISP services in Japan. It operates through Consumer, Enterprise, Distribution, Media/E-commerce, Financial, and others segments. The Consumer segment offers mobile services to individual customers; sells mobile devices; broadband, and supplies electric power. The Enterprise segment provides mobile services to enterprise customers; data centers, cloud services, security, global services, AI, and digital marketing. The Distribution segment sells software, mobile accessories, IoT products. The Media E-Commerce segment provides internet, communication, and advertising related services. The Financial segment offers cashless payment services such as QR code, payments and credit cards, financial services such as banking and asset management, and credit cards, electronic money. It also engages in the planning and production of digital media and content. The company was formerly known as SoftBank Mobile Corp. and changed its name to SoftBank Corp. in May 2015. SoftBank Corp. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Hikari Tsushin, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision and sale of gas and electricity. It operates through Electricity and Gas, Communication, Beverage, Insurance, Finance, Solution, and Sales Agency segments. The company also offers communication line and ancillary services; life and non-life insurance products, and guarantee services; and microfinance. In addition, it manufactures, sells, and delivers natural mineral water; provides industry-specific solutions, such as customer and payment management systems; and operates as a sales agency for various telecommunication products. The company serves individuals, and small and medium-sized enterprises. Hikari Tsushin, Inc. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Toshima, Japan.

MTI Ltd. engages in the content distribution for mobile phones in Japan. It operates through four segments: Content Business, Healthcare Business, School DX Business, and Other Businesses. The company provides content services, including videos, music, books, comics, weather, map and road information services, security-related apps, etc.; original comic works for comic distribution companies; and operates Luna Luna, a health-related information service for women, and a data management service that compiles data, including data on health checkups, medical tests, and lifestyles of individuals; CARADA for medical examination services; and Karada Medica, a Q&A services with doctors. It offers online medical consultation services for clinics and medication instruction services for dispensing pharmacies; cloud-based medication history business for dispensing pharmacies; childcare DX service business for local governments; cloud-based electronic medical record business for clinics; and ICT solutions for dispensing pharmacies, such as electronic medicine notebooks, cloud-based picking apps, etc., as well as provides digital transformation support and solutions for corporations and involved in the AI business. MTI Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

M H Group Ltd. engages in the management of hair salons under the mod's name in Japan. The company manages hair and makeup artists. It also develops private brand products. In addition, the company provides beauty salon support services, as well as engages in hair and makeup, career design related businesses. Further, it is involved in franchisee activities. Additionally, the company sells its products through online store. M H Group Ltd. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Toshin Holdings Co.,Ltd engages in the mobile communication related business in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Mobile Communications, Real Estate, and Resort. The Mobile Communications segment engages in the sale of mobile phones, mobile phone service subscriptions, and related products, purchase of mobile phone terminals, as well as providing financial services, point services, and smartphone-based payment services. The Real Estate segment manages rental office buildings and condominiums, and rental apartments. The Resort segment is involved in resort business activities. The company also operates golf courses and driving ranges; selling drinking water; selling office automation equipment and air conditioners; and managing golf shops. Toshin Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Forval Telecom,Inc. provides telecommunications services in Japan. The company offers billing services; and smart hikari, a broadband communication service for IP telephony and data communication, as well as communication services under the fit Call brand. It also provides IP & mobile solutions, business support solutions, and supply of electricity; and engages in utility business; and security certification acquisition consulting business. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. Forval Telecom,Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Forval Corporation.

SAKAI Holdings CO.,LTD, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the mobile communication equipment sales related business in Japan. It operates through Renewable Energy Business, Mobile Communications Equipment Sales Related Business, Insurance Agency Business, Funeral Business, Real Estate Leasing and Management Business, and Business Solutions Business segments. The company is involved in the management of mobile phone shops; sale of mobile communications equipment to general users and corporate clients; and processing, sale, and brokerage of subscription contracts for mobile communications services. It also engages in the sale of life, medical, and non-life insurance products; funeral, memorial, and after-funeral support services; operation of funeral halls; and rental and management services for real estate properties, including parking lots. In addition, the company is involved in the solar power generation business, which includes the operation management, maintenance, and inspection management of power plants. The company was formerly known as SKI Corp. and changed its name to SAKAI Holdings CO.,LTD in October 2017. SAKAI Holdings CO.,LTD was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

GMO internet group, Inc. provides various internet services in Japan and internationally. It operates through Internet Infrastructure Business, Internet Security Business, Internet Advertising and Media Business, Internet Financial Business, Crypto Asset Business, and Others Segments. The company offers domain, hosting, cloud, payment processing, e-commerce support, EC platform, customer attraction support, provider, free WiFi, web development support, electronic contracts, financial services, AI, and robotics services; and SSL and encryption, brand security, and cybersecurity. It also provides customer attraction support, startup support, user participation media, game platforms, games, research, SEO measures, and advertising support; online securities and FX trading; and online banking services. In addition, the company offers business support and venture capital and art as well as engages in cryptocurrency trading and NFT marketplace-related activities. The company was formerly known as GMO Internet, Inc. and changed its name to GMO internet group, Inc. in September 2022. GMO internet group, Inc. was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Fibergate Inc. operates as a Wi-Fi solution company in Japan. The company offers Wi-Fi Nex, a free Wi-Fi services to the operators of facilities, such as sightseeing attractions, stores, shopping districts, and commercial buildings, and internet connection services to condominiums and apartment buildings. It also provides Event Wi-Fi, a Wi-Fi service for short-term use; Wi-FiBUS, a passenger transport business, which uses mobile communication devices placed on tour buses and pleasure boats, etc., to provide free Wi-Fi to passengers; Medical Wi-Fi, which provides backup for medical institution Wi-Fi maintenance; Cosmic Wi-Fi, a BCP countermeasure service that automatically switches to satellite communication when a mobile phone or fiber-optic internet connection is interrupted in the event of a disaster, enabling continuous Wi-Fi use; One-Touch Wi-Fi, a solution for business that helps configuring and operating dedicated access points or managing accounts; and SHINOBI Wi-Fi, a service that provides Wi-Fi infrastructure and content to meet the needs of foreign visitors to Japan. In addition, the company manufactures and sells wireless routers and access points. Additionally, it offers low-cost network solutions for corporations, including internet provider services, VPN services, and IPv6 transition solutions; FGBB, a unique brand of free Wi-Fi service for tenants; and FG Smart Call, an IoT platform enables users to answer intercom calls on their smartphones. Fibergate Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Aidma Marketing Communication Corporation provides sales promotion support services in the fields of distribution and retail sectors in Japan. It offers ARSS promotional solutions, market research planning, ADIMA big data platform solutions, Web and SP solutions, and promotional support solutions. The company was formerly known as Aidma Corporation and changed its name to Aidma Marketing Communication Corporation in April 2015. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.

Kadokawa Corporation operates as an entertainment company in Japan. It operates through five segments: Publishing and IP Creation, Animation and Live-Action Film, Games, Web Services, and Education. The Publishing and IP Creation segment engages in the publication and sales of books, e-books, magazines, and e-magazines; web advertising sales; and other IP creation-related planning and sale. Its Animation and Live-Action Film segment is involved in the planning, production, and distribution of anime and live-action films; licensing of video distribution rights; and sale of video package software. Its Game segment plans, develops, and sells game software and network games. The Web Service segment engages in the operation of video community services; planning and management of various events; and distribution of mobile content. Its Education segment is involved in the online education business, and planning and operation of vocational schools. In addition, the company engages in planning and sale of character goods; store and facility management; advertising agency; system design, construction, and operation; and event production, management, and hosting. The company was formerly known as Kadokawa Dwango Corporation. Kadokawa Corporation was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in educational, and healthcare and nursing business in Japan and internationally. The company operates classrooms for a range of children including preschoolers to junior high school students. It is also involved in publishing content business, such as issuing and selling publications through sales companies and bookstores; planning, production, purchasing, and sales of publications for kindergartens and nursery schools, childcare supplies, play equipment, apparel for teachers, etc.; and planning, development, and operation of nursing care service centers, mainly housing for the elderly with services. The company was formerly known as Gakken Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2009. Gakken Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Zenrin Co., Ltd. engages in the collection and management of a range of geospatial information worldwide. It manufactures and sells maps, including residential maps, map databases, and other content; and map database maintenance services, as well as provides map services, map software, in-car navigation software, and related IT services. The company also manufactures and sells printed materials; development and sales of web systems; research and development of software; development of map database; development and sales of package system; provides marketing and business solutions; and location-based services. In addition, it is involved in the development of software and services related to Zenrin integrated geospatial system, and corporate venture capital business. Further, the company offers easy sales promotion map, and building point data services; residential map for web, planned maps / custom-made maps, and drone; and 3D map data, logistics services, and ScanX services, as well as engages in mobility solutions business. Zenrin Co., Ltd. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Kitakyushu, Japan.

Shobunsha Holdings, Inc. engages in the planning, producing, and publishing maps, magazines, and guidebooks in Japan. It plans, produces, and sells digital data, as well as provides electronic services. The company also produces maps and guidebooks in foreign languages for tourists; offers tools available on the Internet, smartphones, and in mobile communication; and serves as an advertising media for various range clients in the hotel, transportation, retail, and other industries. In addition, it offers domestic travel guide, including Mapple, Mapple Theme Edition, Kotorippu, Kotorippu Magazine, Color Plus, and Other domestic guides; overseas travel guide, such as Mapple Overseas Edition, Kotorippu Overseas Edition, Mapple WORLD, Travel phrasebook, and Other overseas guides; map products comprising Road map, City walking map, Large format, single-sheet map, World map / Japan map, Mountain and Plateau Map, Touring Mapple, and Other Maps; books and knowledge products, such as Historians, Instruction Manual series, Easily Understandable Series, and Other books; children's books, including Mapple Kids, Mapple Kids: Learn by Sticking, Picture book, globe, and Other children's books; and calender and other products. Further, the company provides digital maps and travel guides for national agencies, local governments, and private enterprises for issues concerning crime and disaster prevention, disaster measures, tourism business, regional marketing, customer management, and logistics. Additionally, it makes maps and develops geographical information systems for enterprises and local governments; provides services ranging from inputting data to developing mapping software; and offers Mapple Navi, a car navigation software for PND makers that provide driving routes and information about restaurants. Shobunsha Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

long_name: SE Holdings and Incubations Co., Ltd.
business_summary: SE Holdings and Incubations Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the publishing business in Japan. The company is involved in the publication and sale of translated books and e-books from overseas; operation of direct sales websites for books and related products; operation of web magazines; provision of web advertising media; media provision; and event business for IT professionals. It also engages in content marketing support services such as marketing consulting, web content creation and owned media development, implementation and operation of marketing automation, and brand localization, etc.; web service planning, development and operation; social game and smartphone app development; IT personnel training and development; and job placement support and recruitment site operation for the medical industry. The company was formerly known as SHOEISHA Co., Ltd. SE Holdings and Incubations Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

long_name: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated
business_summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and retail of electric power in Japan and internationally. It generates power through nuclear, fuel, and thermal, as well as solar, geothermal, hydro, and offshore wind power plants; and engages in the procurement, transportation, and trading of fuel. The company is also involved in the gas supply business. In addition, it provides consulting services, as well as engages in real estate rental business; Uranium mining and smelting; system development and maintenance; design and maintenance of power distribution equipment, sales and management of utility pole advertisements; back-office operations; and sales, construction, repair, leasing, electrical work and management of machinery and equipment. Further, the company is involved in investment projects; hydroelectric power generation business; storage and management; hotel and golf course management; design project; charging service, and charging network service business; and planning, proposals, design and construction related to energy conservation in new and existing buildings, and sales and installation of building equipment, etc. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Electric Power Company, Incorporated and changed its name to Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated in April 2016. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Incorporated is a subsidiary of Nuclear Damage Compensation And Decommissioning Facilitation Corporation.

Chubu Electric Power Company, Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and retail of electricity in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: JERA, Power Grid, and Miraiz. It generates electricity through geothermal, hydro, wind, biomass, and solar sources. The company is also involved in the fuel upstream, power generation procurement, and wholesale of electricity and gas businesses; and provides power network services. In addition, it engages in construction and manufacture related to the energy business. Further, the company is involved in the gas supply and real estate activities. Additionally, the company engages in renewable energy, nuclear power, and community support infrastructure related business, as well as overseas business. Chubu Electric Power Company, Incorporated was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

long_name: The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated
business_summary: The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in electricity, heat supply, telecommunication, and gas supply in Japan. It operates through four segments: Energy Business; Power Transmission and Distribution Business; Information and Communication Business; and Lifestyle and Business Solution Business. The company generates power from thermal, hydropower, wind, biomass, and nuclear power generation plants. It also involved in the power transmission and distribution business; the provision of information and communication services for homes and businesses under the eo Hikari brand; mobile business under the mineo business; corporate solution business; and real estate leasing, sales, and management activities; and leisure, leasing, call center management, medical and health care, and home security businesses. In addition, the company engages in the design, construction, operation, maintenance, and management of power generation, power distribution, electrical, and information communication facilities, and information and communication equipment; manufacture and sale of electrical wiring hardware, insulators, bushings, steel pipe columns, concrete poles, and other electrical distribution equipment and materials; housing equipment sales; construction contracting; renovation work; and passenger/freight transportation. Further, it involved in the survey and research on safety technology for nuclear power generation; survey, design, and construction supervision related to civil engineering, etc.; and provision of survey, analysis, consulting, and construction services related to the environment, civil engineering, and architecture, as well as public relations and engineering services. The Kansai Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

long_name: The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc.
business_summary: The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc. engages in generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Commercial Services, Commercial Operations, and Information and Communications. It generates power through hydroelectric, thermal, nuclear, renewable, and other energy sources. The company provides thermal power, nuclear power, hydroelectric power, transportation facilities, telecommunications, electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing, and other materials and equipment, as well as consulting services. In addition, it owns and operates general hydropower and pumped storage power stations, as well as constructs and operates technology of photovoltaic power plant. Further, the company is involved in natural gas-fired power generation; coal-fired power generation; real estate and building management; insurance agency business; contract services; power transmission and distribution business; manufacturing and sales of concrete products; accounting services; civil engineering and foundation works; coal ash recycling; employee welfare service. The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc. was incorporated in 1951 and is based in Hiroshima, Japan.

Hokuriku Electric Power Company supplies electricity through power generation, transmission, and distribution systems in Japan. The company generates electricity through hydroelectric, thermal, and nuclear sources. It is also involved in the sale of LNG; construction of thermal and nuclear power plant equipment; architecture, civil engineering, and paving works; design and construction business; maintenance of hydroelectric power generation substation; distribution facilities; electricity, air conditioning, water supply and drainage, communication equipment construction, and plumbing business; and manufacturing and sale of concrete poles and piles. The company also engages in providing data transmission line and office support work services; development and sale of software, logistics management system, and stem contract; real estate rental and management, temporary staffing, and leasing business; energy solutions, home sales, and gas retail business; execution of environmental greening projects; civil engineering and construction works; administrative services related to administrative indirect operations. In addition, it is involved in investment management business; manufacturing, repair and testing of electricity meters; manufacturing and sales of transformers and switchboards; cable television broadcasting service and internet service; construction and operation of black pellet manufacturing plants. The company was incorporation in 1951 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.

Tohoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated operates as an energy service in Japan and internationally. It generates and supplies electricity through hydroelectric, thermal, wind, solar, nuclear power stations. Tohoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

Shikoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in generating, transmitting, distributing, and selling electricity in Japan and internationally. The company generates electricity through nuclear, thermal, hydro, solar, and other sources. It is also involved in the telecommunication and information system services; cable TV broadcasting; studying, designing, engineering, and maintenance of electricity-related facilities; planning and designing of civil engineering and construction; engineering work for power supply facilities; and sales and engineering of electric water heaters and air-conditioning systems. In addition, the company engages in the construction and operation of LNG fuel bases; storage and delivery of LNG; investment and financing for overseas projects; procurement, sale, and trading of coal; and the manufacture and sale of automatic gauging control and information transmission systems. Further, it is involved in real estate businesses; planning and production of advertisements; office-related services; and research and development of technologies related to the electric utility business and other businesses. As of March 31, 2026, it operated electric power generating facilities with a total capacity of 5,336 MW, including 1,158 MW of hydro, 3,285 MW of thermal, 890 MW of nuclear, and 3 MW of solar power generating facilities. The company serves 7,406 million kWh to residential; and 15,488 million kWh to industrial and commercial customers. Shikoku Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.

Kyushu Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in the power generation, transmission, distribution, and retail in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Power Generation and Sales Business, Transmission and Distribution Business, Overseas Businesses, ICT Services Business, Urban Development Business, and Other Energy Services Business segments. It is also involved in construction and maintenance of electrical equipment; sale of gas / LNG and coal; renewable energy business; data communication; optical broadband; telecommunications construction and maintenance; information system development; public-private partnership, and data center business. Further, the company develops and manages real estate. Kyushu Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

Hokkaido Electric Power Company, Incorporated generates, transmits, and distributes electricity in Japan. The company undertakes electrical and telecommunication, civil engineering and construction, piping, air-conditioning, water supply and drainage facility, and disaster prevention equipment works, as well as engages in the manufacture, maintenance, sale, and electric meters. It also engages in energy conservation business; sale of fuel, equipment and materials; civil engineering and construction materials; rental condominiums and apartments, and parking lot business; and travel, insurance agency, utility pole advertising, cleaning/security service business, and public bathhouse business. In addition, the company provides construction consultant services for civil engineering, construction, electricity, environment, and energy; electricity meter inspection and billing, energy conservation, and energy-saving services; telecommunication services; information processing system consulting, development, operation, management, training, sale of information processing equipment and software, internet data center business, and other information processing-related services; and document management improvement, and confidential document destruction and recycling services. Further, it engages in the commissioning, repairing, maintaining, and consulting for power generation facilities; and receipt, storage, and delivery of overseas coal, maritime transport agent, and customs clearance business. Additionally, the company designs, prints, book binds, and produces broadcasts and videos; sells novelties, gift products, and everyday goods, food, etc.; leases LNG receiving facilities; inspection agency business; and operates and maintains thermal, hydroelectric, photovoltaic, and wind power generation plants. Hokkaido Electric Power Company, Incorporated was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

long_name: The Okinawa Electric Power Company, Incorporated
business_summary: The Okinawa Electric Power Company, Incorporated engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity in Okinawa Prefecture, Japan. It operates through two segments: the Electric Power Business and Construction Business segments. The company generates electricity from thermal sources. It also offers civil engineering, architectural, electrical, plumbing, piping and telecommunications works, as well as construction and maintenance of power equipment. In addition, the company is involved in repair and contract operation of internal combustion power generation; contract driving, sales and repair of electrical equipment; operation and inspection of electrical machinery equipment; manufacturing, repair and inspection fees for electric meters; land and building management and leasing, and land business; contracting out of work; design, construction, operation and sales of computers and peripherals; survey, design and construction supervision of power facilities; environmental surveys; contract for electrification system consulting business; colocation services and call center operations; and wind power generation. The Okinawa Electric Power Company, Incorporated was founded in 1972 and is based in Urasoe, Japan.

Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. operates as electric utility company in Japan. The company operates through Power generation business, Power transmission and transformation business, Electricity-related businesses, and Other business segments. It develops and operates hydroelectric power plants with total owned capacity of 8,560 MW; wind power with total owned capacity of 485 MW; geothermal power with total owned capacity of 100 MW; thermal power; solar; biomass; wind power; and nuclear business; as well as provides consulting services. Electric Power Development Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

EF-ON Inc. operates as an energy service company in Japan. The company operates through Energy Conservation Support Service Business and Green Energy Business segments. The company is also involved in the electricity retail and forestry business. It offers, products such as boiler and hot water supply equipment, compressors, refrigerators, air conditioning equipment, lighting equipment, and other equipment. The company maintains and operates forest, as well as generates electricity from unused wood and construction waste, and supplies. It was formerly known as The First Energy Service Company Limited and changed its name to EF-ON Inc. in October 2016. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

eREX Co.,Ltd. engages in the electric power business in Japan. The company operates biomass power plants; and engages in a hydrogen power generation demonstration project. It is also involved in the development and production of biomass fuels from wood pellets; carbon credit business; electricity trading; and electricity retailing to corporate and individual consumers. eREX Co.,Ltd. incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

RENOVA, Inc. engages in the development and operation of renewable energy power plant in Japan. It operates through Renewable Energy Power Generation Business and Development and Operation Business segments. The Renewable Energy Power Generation Business segment generates and sells electricity from renewable energy power plants. The Development and Operation Business develops and assists in the operation of renewable energy power plants. It generates electricity through solar, biomass, onshore wind, geothermal, and hydro power plants, as well as engages in energy storage business. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Tokyo Gas Co.,Ltd. engages in the production, supply, and sale of city gas and LNG in Japan. It operates through Energy Solutions, Network, Overseas, and Urban development segments. The company is involved in the production, supply, and sale of electricity; provision of engineering solutions and energy services, gas appliances, gas construction, as well as transmission service of city gas; and trading activities. It also provides overseas resource development and investment; and energy supply. In addition, the company engages in the real estate development; and leasing and management of land and buildings. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Gas Company and changed its name to Tokyo Gas Co.,Ltd. in July 1893. Tokyo Gas Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1885 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Osaka Gas Co., Ltd. provides natural gas, electricity, and other energy products and services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Domestic Energy, Overseas Energy, and Life & Business Solutions. The Domestic Energy Business segment manufactures, supplies, and sells city gas; sells gas appliances; installs gas pipelines; sells and transports LNG; sells LPG and industrial gas; and generates and sells electricity, as well as engineering and construction for gas and environmental facilities. The Overseas Energy Business segment engages in development and investment related to natural gas; and supply of energy. The Life & Business Solutions Business segment is involved in real estate development and rental; information processing services; and the sale of fine materials and carbon material products. In addition, it is involved in home renovation; the sales of heat supply; engineering; operation, management, and maintenance of buildings and facilities; software development; manufacturing and selling fine materials, carbon material products, activated carbon, and wood protective coating. Osaka Gas Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1897 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Toho Gas Co., Ltd. engages in the gas, LPG and other energy, electric power, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the extraction and trade of natural gas and other energy resources; sale of coke, tar products, petroleum products, paving materials, automobiles, daily necessities, food, and beverages; design, supervision, and construction of civil engineering, architectural, electrical, plumbing, and machinery installation works; and sale, leasing, and management of real estate. It also manufactures, transports, and sells high-pressure gases, including liquefied natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas, and liquefied carbon dioxide; gas appliances, air conditioning equipment, kitchen equipment, water supply and drainage equipment, and household electrical appliances; and methanol and plasticizers. In addition, the company engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of air pollution prevention equipment, water pollution prevention equipment, and waste treatment equipment for environmental conservation; soil regeneration treatment; production, sale, and rental of computer-related hardware and software; and sale and rental of crime prevention and disaster prevention equipment. Further, it provides information processing and provision services, communication services, and security services, as well as surveys, research, and consulting services. Additionally, the company is involved in the management of cooking classes, cultural classes, sports facilities, hot spring facilities, training facilities, rental conference rooms, and accommodation facilities; restaurant business and travel agency business; general leasing, finance, advertising, labor dispatch and truck transportation; and non-life insurance agency and life insurance solicitation businesses. Toho Gas Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Hokkaido Gas Co., Ltd. engages in gas business in Japan. It is also involved in the purification and sale of gas by-products; heat and power supply businesses; production and sale of gas appliances, as well as related construction works; and other related works. The company was incorporated in 1911 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. produces, supplies, and sells natural gas in Japan. It operates through four segments: Gas, LPG, Electricity and Other Energy, and Real Estate. The Gas segment includes the production, supply, and sale of city gas, sales of gas appliances, gas piping construction, LNG sales, and renovation services. The LPG segment covers the sale of LPG, LPG equipment, and related construction work. The Electricity and Other Energy segment comprises electricity sales, heat supply, and solar power generation, as well as international energy business such as overseas LNG shipments. The Real Estate segment involves the sale, leasing, and management of real estate, including residential construction and land development. The company also provides information processing services, investment activities, restaurant operations, and manufactures and sells carbon materials, paints, and chemical products. The company was formerly known as Saibu Gas Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. in April 2021. Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

METAWATER Co., Ltd. designs and constructs facilities for water treatment plants, sewage treatment plants, and waste treatment facilities in Japan and internationally. It operates in four segments: Environmental Engineering Business, System Solutions Business, Operation Business, and International segments. The company engages in the design, construction, maintenance, and inspection of mechanical equipment for domestic water and sewage treatment plants and resource recycling facilities; and design, manufacture, maintenance, and management of electrical equipment for domestic water and sewage treatment plants, as well as facilities and equipment for international water and sewage treatment plants, and private sector business. It also operates domestic water and sewage treatment plants and resource recycling facilities; cloud-based platform to support the operation, maintenance, and management of facilities. In addition, the company offers implementation, maintenance, repair, and refurbishing of machines and electrical equipment. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. engages in the mergers and acquisitions (M&A) intermediary activities in Japan. It operates M&A sites and media. The company serves various industries comprising construction, human resources, IT/communication/system development, transportation, real estate, treatment/welfare/nursing, finance/insurance, travel, food and beverages, education, retail, service, manufacturing, leisure facilities, and environment/bio. The company was formerly known as M&A Research Institute Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. in January 2026. Quants Research Institute Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

MicroAd, Inc. operates an advertising platform that connects advertisers and the media in Japan. It offers data product services and consulting services. It provides proprietary products with an increasing return on investment model. Additionally, it offers Universe Ads, an advertising platform that analyzes data and distributes advertisements for marketing needs of various industries; and MicroAd COMPASS, a supply-side platform that enhances media ad distribution and maximizes advertising revenue through comprehensive management. The company also provides MONOLITHS, a system that manages the digital OOH network provided by MADS; Outside TV, a cloud-based content management service that provides elements necessary for digital signage operation in one place; LinX, a brand lift measurement solution that visualizes brand recognition rate and product favorability; Enhance Publisher Trading Desk, an advertising distribution menu that allows users to segment target users based on data held by the media and perform targeted distribution; Enhance media monetization consulting services to maximize media value and support comprehensive monetization; and OCTAVE, a tablet-based signage service specialized for beauty salons. MicroAd, Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. MicroAd, Inc. is a subsidiary of CyberAgent Inc.

INTLOOP Inc. provides system development, network construction, infrastructure implementation, and IT human resources services in Japan and internationally. The company also offers PMO, web services, professional recruitment support and human resource utilization service, technology solutions. In addition, it operates QEEE, comprehensive portal site; and BOOSTA, a human resource development service. Further, the company offers FUKURINT, a tax support application system. Additionally, it is involved in apparel sales businesses. INTLOOP Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

airCloset, Inc. operates as a fashion technology company providing an online fashion rental platform in Japan. The company offers fashion rental service for women under the airCloset and airCloset Dress brand names; and airCloset Salon, a bone structure and color diagnosis salon. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Japaniace Co.,Ltd. engages in the advanced engineering business in Japan. The company offers on-site development support and contract development; software design, development, testing, operation, and maintenance services for the IT, communications, and manufacturing industries; network and server design and construction, operation, and maintenance services for telecommunications carriers, finance, distribution, and government agencies; and mechanical and electrical design of products and equipment for the automotive, office automation, digital equipment, and robotics sectors. It also engages in advanced technology services, including Al, IoT, and cloud computing; research, development, and analytical support services for chemical, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, food, and material manufacturers, as well as the academia, public institutions, and contract testing companies; dispatch of engineers in specialized fields; job placement services for the real estate, facilities, and construction industries; and educational services. In addition, the company is involved in the development and software evaluation of web systems and applications, business and financial systems, and public institution systems; virtual infrastructure construction and operation; system operation and maintenance; security response; system implementation and migration support; function addition and customization; integration with other systems; design and construction of AWS, Azure, and GCP environments; cloud migration support; chemical testing, analysis, and measurement; bio cell and genetic experiments; research and analysis using natural language processing; and inspection and analysis using image processing. Japaniace Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

PROGRIT Inc. provides English coaching and subscription-based English learning services in Japan. It offers Progrit, an English coaching service; Progrit FOR ENTERPRISE, a custom-made English training for corporations that provides a range of services, including identifying issues, conducting training, and follow-up support; Shadow Ten, a subscription shadowing and correction service to improve listening skills; Spiffle, a subscription service to improve English speaking skills through oral English composition and one-minute speeches; and Dear Talk, an English conversation service. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

GLAD CUBE Inc. operates as an internet advertising agency in Japan. It operates through the Marketing DX Business and Technology Business segments. The company offers listing advertising management agency services, including listing advertisements, Facebook ads, Instagram ads, X (Twitter) ads, LINE ads, YouTube ads, application advertising, video advertisement production and operation, Apple search ads, DSP applications, Amazon ads, and beauty mail order/salon/clinic advertising operations, seminars, and free newsletter registration. It also provides production, analysis, and consulting services, such as website creation, vertical short drama production, access analysis, LPO/CRO consulting, LLMO/AIO countermeasures, and contract development services. In addition, the company offers SiTest, a tool for website analytics; SPAIA, an AI sports media platform; and SPAIA Horse Racing, a subscription-based service that extracts horse racing content. GLAD CUBE Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Atlas Technologies Corporation provides fintech consulting and project execution support services in Japan. The company offers consulting and project implementation support services in the insurance field; and services in the IT risk and PMO support fields. It is also involved in planning, consulting, project management, development, and operation of fintech businesses. The company serves banking and capital markets, payment, and insurance industries. Atlas Technologies Corporation was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

FCE Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the digital transformation promotion business, education and training business, and other businesses in Japan. The company operates through DX Promotion, Education and Training, and Others segments. It offers IT tools, consulting, and support to promote corporate DX for robotic process automation; and programs and services to schools and cram schools. The company also provides human resource development consulting and training; and e-learning tools services for education and HR fields. In addition, it publishes books and offers reading community management, and self-coaching programs. FCE Inc., was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

GLOE Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the e-sports business in Japan. It engages in the planning and managing e-sports and gaming events for game makers and developers; and game-related marketing solutions. The company was formerly known as Wellplayed Rizest Inc. and changed its name to GLOE Inc. in February 2024. GLOE Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan. The company operates as a subsidiary of KAYAC Inc.

Toho Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the film business in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Film Business, IP and Anime Business, Theatrical Business, Real Estate Business, and Other segments. The company is involved in the planning and production of films; utilization of rights, including video streaming; management of cinema complexes; and other video production, art production, and advertising activities. It also engages in the development, production, and rights management of TOHO animation titles, as well as licensing operations for Godzilla; production and exhibition of theatrical plays; and management of entertainment production. In addition, the company is involved in the leasing of office buildings and commercial facilities; road maintenance, repair, and cleaning; and building maintenance, including cleaning, facility management, and security for buildings. Further, it engages in distribution to movie theatres; licensing of merchandising rights; sales and merchandising activities; and operation of sports facilities. Toho Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1932 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

H.I.S. Co., Ltd. is involved in the arrangement, planning, and sales of overseas and domestic travel, as well as related businesses in Japan, the United States, the rest of Asia, Oceania, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Travel Business, Hotel Business, and Kyushu Sanko Group. It also operates hotels, as well as engages in automobile transportation and real estate rental. In addition, the company owns and operates a theme park; provides non-life insurance services, focusing on overseas travel insurance; and develops and operates room reservation systems and related businesses. Further, it engages in facility management; machinery installation and maintenance; and infrastructure projects, such as construction and construction of new buildings. The company was formerly known as International Tours Co., Ltd. and changed its name to H.I.S. Co., Ltd. in 1990. H.I.S. Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Toei Company, Ltd., a content company, engages in the production and distribution of movies, television (TV) shows, and other video products in Japan. The company produces and distributes theatrical films, TV programs, and educational videos; engages in the video licensing business; produces and sells CDs, DVDs, Blu-ray discs, and games; licenses character merchandising rights and copyrights of films and programs; manages theaters and cinema complexes; and runs character shows related to films and videos. It also produces, plans, and holds cultural events; operates TOEI Kyoto studio park and Kyoto film studio; and engages in the construction work and contract interior decoration activities, as well as online sales of products. In addition, the company engages in the rental of commercial buildings, office buildings, and condominiums; owns commercial complexes; and operates and manages hotels. Toei Company, Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

LuckLand Co., Ltd. engages in the research, planning and development, design, construction, supervision, and maintenance services of commercial facilities, retail and food service establishments, logistics facilities, food factories, and hotels. The company is involved in the shop facility construction business comprising site survey, building equipment survey, planning, design, and construction; commercial facility construction business, including building equipment, interior decoration supervision, large store site law adjustment, equipment design, and construction; food factory/logistics warehouse construction business; environmental sector business; and construction, building equipment, and refrigeration equipment businesses. LuckLand Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Kyoritsu Maintenance Co., Ltd. operates dormitories for students and companies. The company operates through Dormitory Business, Hotel business, Comprehensive Building Management Business, Foods Business, Development Business, and other segments. It manages and operates student and employee dormitories, share houses, studio apartment-type dormitories, business and resort hotels; operates hotels under the Dormy Inn name; office building management business, and residential building management business; restaurant business, contract catering business, contract management of hotel restaurants; construction, planning, design, and brokerage businesses; condominium development businesses; real estate securitization businesses; and management and operation of housing for the senior life business. Kyoritsu Maintenance Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the automotive leasing, chemical, parking, machine tool, synthetic resin, and agriculture businesses in Japan. The company is involved in automobile leasing, fuel sale, and automotive maintenance and outsourcing services; manufacturing of professional-use, techno, fine, and consumer chemical products; and operation of parking lots and plots for supermarkets and hospitals, parking garages affiliated with tenant buildings, and idle lands. It also engages in the development and sale of automotive, industrial machine, air conditioning, and do-it-yourself tools, as well as provision of third-party logistics services; design, manufacturing, and sale of synthetic resins and raw materials, amusement game peripherals, automotive decorative parts, and machinery and tools for processing molds; cultivation and sale of crops, as well as development, manufacturing, and sale of fertilizers; and manufacturing and sale of curved, tempered, laminated, insulating, and decorative glasses, as well as processed glass products. The company was formerly known as Kuroda Shoji Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd. in September 2008. Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. provides professional consulting services in Japan, Asia, the United Kingdom, Europe, and internationally. The company offers professional consulting services related to civil engineering and construction works, such as planning, research, design, and supervision services; disaster countermeasures for floods, droughts, tsunamis, and storm surges; watershed hydrology; seismic countermeasures for river management and coastal protection facilities; port and marine infrastructure; and mechanical and electrical equipment. It is also involved in the planning and design of new dams; provision of solutions for existing dams; sediment disaster countermeasures, including disaster surveys and forecasts; planning, design, and maintenance of erosion control facilities, such as check dams and stream protection works; non-mechanical measures; design of pipes, drains, and related facilities; evaluation of the seismic performance of related structures; design of aseismic reinforcement works; detection of structural degradation; and formulation of asset management plans. In addition, the company plans and designs mechanical equipment for weirs, floodgates, locks, sluice pipes and gates, floodwall gates, and drainage pump stations in river systems; dam discharge facilities; and water treatment facilities for water supply and sewerage systems. Further, it provides traffic planning and operation, and logistics business plans; planning and designing of bridges; regional transportation systems, district transportation plans, and support for transportation projects; information and telecommunications technology, disaster mitigation, environment, and geo-environment services; public procurement assistance; and construction and execution management services. The company was formerly known as Kensetsu Gijyutsu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. in February 1964. The company was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Space Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, design, supervision, and construction of commercial facilities in Japan. The company's commercial facilities include shopping centers, department stores, specialty stores, and restaurants. It is also involved in the planning, design, supervision, and construction of museums and other cultural, sports, and entertainment facilities, as well as urban development, regional development, and environmental improvement projects; and planning, design, production, sale, and import and export of exhibition equipment and display fixtures, indoor and outdoor decorative items, and furniture. It also engages in the purchase and sale of secondhand goods and entrusted services; and business incidental to all preceding items. In addition, the company plans, designs, supervises, and executes construction and interior finishing works; and plans, designs, supervises, and constructs projects related to shows and exhibitions. Further, it is involved in the planning, design, and production related to public relations and advertising; research, consultation, and publishing related to various items; provision of information; and real estate dealings, leasing, and brokerage activities. Space Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Ain Holdings Inc. engages in the management of pharmacies, cosmetic stores, and interior shops in Japan. The company operates and manages dispensing and insurance pharmacies; and sells generic drugs. It is also involved in the provision of management consulting services for medical institutions; dissemination of information on hospital management; and introduction and dispatch of medical personnel, etc. In addition, the company operates cosmetic stores under the AINZ & TULPE; and interior furnishing shops under the Francfranc brand name. Further, it manages convenience stores. The company was formerly known as Ain Pharmaciez Inc. and changed its name to Ain Holdings Inc. in November 2015. Ain Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

SAN Holdings, Inc. provides funeral services in Japan. The company offers a line of services and support before and after funerals, including consultation and assistance in inheritance and other procedures, a residence, and other matters; real estate management services; and conducts farewell events. SAN Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

PCA Corporation develops and sells computer software in Japan. The company offers accounting solutions, including bill management option, consolidated settlement option, data linkage option, workflow, payment management, cost management, cost management for construction industry, international trading, and consolidated accounting solutions. It also provides HR management solutions comprising time clock, shift management, attendance management workflow, payment statement electronic distribution, social insurance and labor insurance management, payment record, daily payroll, and business form design solutions. In addition, the company offers order entry simultaneous entry option, sales/purchase simultaneous entry option, convenience store receiving agent option, data linkage option, specified slip issuance, POS cash register, sales force automation (SFA), customer management, handy terminal, EDI, and business form design solutions. PCA Corporation was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Subaru Enterprise Co., Ltd. engages in the maintenance and cleaning of roads and road ancillary facilities in Japan. The company is also involved in the contracting for maintenance, cleaning, repair work, and related facilities; operation of expressways and highway shops; and operation and management of marinas, cafes, and restaurants. In addition, it engages in the solar power generation business; restaurants and café management services; installation and sales of vending machines; sale of foodstuffs and drinking water, as well as sales of alcoholic beverages and disaster prevention goods; marina operation business; and real estate leasing activities. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Subaru Enterprise Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Toho Co., Ltd.

Tokyo Theatres Company, Incorporated engages in the video-related, food and beverages, real estate and other businesses in Japan. The company is involved in the real estate rental business; rental office and restaurant management activities; refurbishment and renovation of used condominiums and apartments; and processing and sale of food ingredients. It also engages in the production and distribution of movies and dramas; advertising and event planning business; and movie box office business. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Musashino Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the film, real estate, and commercial businesses in Japan. It operates through Movie Business, Real Estate Business, Commercial Business, and Driving Instruction Business segments. The company offers film exhibitions; and distributes and operates movie theater concession stands. It is also involved in the sale of real estate properties, as well as brokerage, investment, and rental of tenant buildings, etc. In addition, the company operates driving schools; sells housing materials; and operates restaurants and other businesses on a contract basis. Musashino Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Kin-Ei Corp. engages in the management and operation of rental buildings for movie theaters in Japan. It operates through two segments: Cinema and Amusement Business and Real Estate Business. The company is involved in film exhibitions, building rental, tenant leasing, and other related businesses, as well as game center operations. It also manages entertainment venues. In addition, the company engages in transportation, real estate, international logistics, distribution, hotel, and resort businesses. The company was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Kin-Ei Corp. operates as a subsidiary of Kintetsu Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.

Sankyo Frontier Co.,Ltd. produces, sells, and rents modular buildings, self-storage, and multi-storey parking devices in Japan and internationally. It also offers plant factory facility, a system that artificially controls the environmental conditions necessary for plant growth. The company products are used in various applications, such as sports and leisure facilities, construction site offices, emergency temporary housing, food and beverage establishment, warehouses, offices, and schools. Sankyo Frontier Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Kashiwa, Japan. Sankyo Frontier Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Wako.

Saison Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the system development and operation, and software package businesses in Japan. It operates through HULFT Business, Data Platform Business, and System Outsourcing Business segments. The company offers HULFT, a data management solution; HULFT Square and DataSpider Servista, which are cloud-based data integration platforms; HULFT 10, enables transfer and share files between systems; HULFT DataCatalog, that catalogs various scattered data; HULFT-HUB, a data integration relay hub; DataMagic, that provides data conversion processing for business systems; HULFT-WebConnect, a file transfer service. Further, it provides various services, including AI-powered services, data integration platform construction, building a data utilization platform, core system/ERP integration platform, CRM integration platform, HR system integration platform, file integration platform, and support for in-house data integration. The company was formerly known as Saison Information Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Saison Technology Co., Ltd. in April 2024. Saison Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Tanabe Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the management consulting activities in Japan. The company provides strategy consultants for business management, business model transformation, food, manufacturing, construction, global business, government, and public services; digital consultant includes DX vision, digital marketing, management DX, and strategy and operations; HR consultant for strategic HR, human capital management, recruitment and career design, corporate university, top management programs, HR tech, and talent assessment; and marketing and sales consultant includes new business ventures run by female teams, customer creation for existing businesses, on-site sales support, DE&I support, sales design, and customer success. It also provides corporate well-being consultants for clinical psychologists, mental health and welfare workers, public health nurses, industrial counselors, CEAP, and career consultant; corporate finance consultant includes holdings and group management, business succession, ipo support, alliances, and management systems; merger and acquisition consultant for growth strategy, business succession, financial advisory, and cross-border; brand and PR consultant includes branding, public relations, strategic PR and overseas PR, SNS management, and content marketing management support; and CRM consultant for client relations, MA tools, database marketing, and telemarketing. The company was formerly known as Tanabe Consulting Co.,Ltd. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kyowa Engineering Consultants Co., Ltd. provides construction consulting services in Japan and internationally. The company offers structure construction and maintenance services, such as survey, planning, and design of bridges, underground structures, water and sewage facilities, tunnels, utility tunnels, etc.; inspection and repair technologies; and construction management services. It also provides regional development and creation services, including urban development, survey, planning, and design of roads, parks, green spaces, and land development; surveys, predictions, and countermeasures for the social and natural environment; and offers landscape studies. In addition, the company provides disaster prevention and mitigation services comprising investigation, planning, and design of rivers, waterways, sluice gates, and related facilities; erosion control-related investigation and planning services; and geotechnical and hydrological investigations and analyses. Further, it offers energy resource surveys for solar, hydro, wind, and biomass; implementation planning and design services; regional utilization plans; and building support services. Additionally, the company provides architecture services, such as seismic diagnosis of buildings, seismic design, and improvement of the asset value of building facilities. It offers investigation and design of drinking water development projects; construction supervision and support for non-revenue water countermeasures; and support for renewable energy development, as well as promotes small-scale hydropower generation. The company also engages in real estate rental and management activities; information processing, personnel dispatch; and software development activities; and sale of information processing equipment. It serves government agencies. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Japan Process Development Co., Ltd. provides system integration and software development services in Japan. The company develops control systems, such as power plant monitoring and control, automated power distribution, bullet and local train traffic control, and transport management systems, as well as training simulators for power plant operators; automotive systems, including onboard control, engine control and transmissions control, external recognition, central gateway control, and car navigation systems; and particular information systems comprising satellite imagery ground, image analysis, sound-related, geographical information, and remote sensing systems. It also offers embedded systems consists of solid-state drives, IoT construction machines, and medical equipment; and industry and ICT solutions, such as rail ticket vending and station ticket counter machines, weather radars, and IoT security and image classification systems, as well as constructs private cloud environments. Japan Process Development Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Greenland Resort Company Limited engages in the tourism and hotel businesses in Japan. The company manages amusement parks and golf courses. It also engages in restaurant management and real estate businesses. Greenland Resort Company Limited was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Arao, Japan.

Kabuki-Za Co., Ltd. engages in the leasing of real estate in Japan. The company operates and manages restaurants and food establishments, shops, and cafeterias. It also rents land; operates eateries; and sells souvenirs, and other items. Kabuki-Za Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Tokyotokeiba Co.,Ltd. engages in rental of horse racing facilities in Japan. The company is involved in rental of auto racetracks, as well as provision of Oi Racecourse, a racecourse that holds night races. It also engages in management of amusement park; and rental of warehouse, commercial, and logistics facilities, as well as betting systems. In addition, the company offers construction management services and maintenance services for air conditioning equipment. Further, it manages and operates shopping malls and office buildings. Additionally, the company operates restaurants. Tokyotokeiba Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

HORAI Co., Ltd. engages in the insurance, real estate, dairy, and golf businesses in Japan. The company offers insurance agency services, including automobile, fire, and other non-life insurance, as well as life, and term and cancer insurance. It also engages in the rental, buying, selling, and brokerage of office buildings and residential properties, as well as leasing land to solar power generation companies. In addition, the company operates Senbonmatsu ranch; manufactures and sells milk and dairy products; and engages in breeding, milking, and feed production of dairy cattle. Further, it is involved in the management of restaurants, amusement facilities, and other industrial tourism facilities; and operation of Horai Country Club and Nishinasuno Country Club. The company was incorporated in 1928 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

DTS Corporation provides systems integration services in Japan. It operates through Operations & Solutions, Technology & Solutions, and Platforms & Services segments. The company offers Amazon Workspace; ASTERIA Warp, a non- programming collaboration tools; Unifinity, a mobile app no-code development platform; intra-mart; TERASOLUNA; DAVinCI LABS; GeneXus; SkyPDF, a paperless solution; Network Integration Services; BizWise, an application package for insurance agents; Snowflake, A data utilization platform; mcframe, a global supply chain management industry; ReSM and ReSM plus, a platform for operation and employee support desk service; AMLion, an anti-money laundering software; eG-Connector; walk in home; kintone; PCI DSS; Re Notes; VDI solution; and SAP. It also provides intra-mart; DaTaStudio@WEB; ServiceNow; Store Intelligence; GalleriaSolo; Geminiot, AI-based 3rd generation BI; Pasteriot.mi, a manufacturing data utilization solutions; Atlassian, an agile and devOps solutions; Statistical analysis migration service; administrative support tools for banks and credit unions; RiskRecon by mastercard, a third party cyber risk assessment; Secure Workplace; geminiot; SkyPDF; Atlassian; Outsystems, an AI powered low-code platform; Secure Workplace, a corporate productivity and resilience management; Informatica, a data integration platform; Informatica; BizWise; and TRM labs, a crypto tracking and management tool. The company serves finance, insurance, local and government agencies, information and communications, retail and distribution, manufacturing, architecture and real estate, and medical and welfare industries. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. operates in the content and service businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Digital Entertainment Business, Amusement Business, Publishing Business, and Rights and Properties Business segments. The company plans, develops, sells, and manages digital entertainment content primarily in the form of computer games. It is also involved in the operation of amusement facilities; planning, development, manufacture, sale, and rental of arcade game machines and related products. In addition, the company publishes and licenses comic books, magazines, game-related books, periodicals, etc. Further, it plans, produces, develops, and licenses secondary works; and offers content under the SQUARE ENIX PRODUCTS brand. Additionally, the company develops derivative products and services including planning, manufacturing, and selling merchandise; managing music-related projects; organizing events, concerts, and exhibitions; and operating official stores, pop-up shops, collaboration cafés, and driving licensing initiatives. Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

KYCOM Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, consults, plans, designs, develops, and maintains information systems in Japan. The company operates in four segments: Information Processing Business, Real Estate Business, Rental Business, and Wireless Solutions Business. It offers system development, IT consulting and services, infrastructure construction, operation and maintenance support, data entry work, help desk, outsourcing contracted business, development and sale of fingerprint authentication systems, and leasing of office equipment and computer devices. The company also provides wireless communication solutions, including installation, repair, inspection, and maintenance of wireless equipment, as well as disaster prevention. In addition, it is involved in the management of apartment buildings; solar power generation; and car rental business. The company was formerly known as Kyodo Computer Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to KYCOM Holdings Co., Ltd. in June 2011. KYCOM Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Fukui, Japan.

Toyo Tec Co.,Ltd. provides security services in Japan. The company offers mechanical, home, transportation, and facility security services. It is also involved in ATM management, building management, construction and equipment sales, and real estate related services, as well as act as an insurance agency.
