In addition, the company offers mechanical security system, on-site, transport, and crowd security, image monitoring services, surveillance cameras, employee ID cards, fireproof/theft proof safes, and AEDs (automated external defibrillators); and video surveillance, crowd control, access control, sales collection and ATM management, building maintenance, call center, safety confirmation, disaster preparedness, parking lot management, energy saving, infectious disease prevention, and management work services. Toyo Tec Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

KSK Co.,Ltd. engages in the LSI, software, hardware, customer service, and data entry businesses. It operates through System Core Business; IT Solutions Business; and Network Service Business segments. The company engages in semiconductor design, such as LSIs and FPGAs; image sensors; mechanical and electrical design; embedded software development; and IoT solutions, as well as BPO business. It also provides standard information platform for the housing industry, and system development and operation for home builders; cloud-based business support tools for the building maintenance; mobile app development; production management system; pay roll system; and accounting system. In addition, the company is involved in the operation and maintenance work; and design and construction of cloud environments, as well as provision of consulting services. KSK Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Inagi, Japan.

Ryomo Systems Co.,Ltd. provides software development and system sales, information processing, product-related sales, and other information services in Japan. It offers administrative, family register information comprehensive, financial accounting, counter support, school lunch, smart city, and collection management solutions; water rate adjustment, public enterprise accounting system, image information management system, as well as toll collection, water supply installation management, and other meter data information creation solution; and educational network construction, school affairs and class support, and library management services. The company also provides customer portals for gas and electricity retailing; customer charge management, and gas business management solutions; and solutions for manufacturing industry. In addition, it offers printing and functional safety solutions; MBD consulting, autonomous driving system verification, commissioned development, check tool, and education training solutions, as well as HILS support solutions; medical solutions, such as medical office, drug management guidance work support, and regional medical collaboration, electronic medical record systems, and other solutions; and solutions for sales and customer management, online shopping, POS data analysis, electronic commerce, and labor scheduling programs in the distribution sector. Further, the company provides cloud service, share box, electronic eco filing system, counter measure service, housing service, network service, data center, facility equipment, managed, printing, and data entry service, and website design service. The company was formerly known as Ryomo Computing Center Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ryomo Systems Co.,Ltd. in June 1982. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Kiryu, Japan. Ryomo Systems Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsuba Corporation.

Computer Engineering & Consulting Ltd. operates as an independent system integrator in Japan. It operates through Integration, Connected, and Solution segments. The company offers system development, construction, maintenance, and operation services; ICT implementation support; package software installation support; temporary staffing; information systems planning; and infrastructure design, development, and operation services, as well as services based on the use and analysis of digital data. It also provides CRM/ERP, migration, My Number, mobility, security, smart factory, AI/IoT, connected, digital transformation (DX), data center, and cloud solutions. In addition, the company is involved in the development and sale of systems and packages. It serves the manufacturing, logistics and distribution, financial, and medical industries; government agencies, local authorities, and public organizations; and sales and general affairs departments. Computer Engineering & Consulting Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Capcom Co., Ltd. plans, develops, manufactures, sells, and distributes home video game software, mobile content, and amusement equipment in Japan, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Digital Contents Business, Amusement Facilities Business, Amusement Equipment Business, and Other Business segments. The Digital Contents Business develops and sells home video games and mobile content. The Amusement Facilities Business operates stores equipped with game machines, as well as retail stores. The Amusement Equipment Business segment develops, manufactures, and sells amusement machines and other related products to store operators and other businesses. The Other Business engages in character-based businesses. In addition, the company operates amusement facilities. Capcom Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Creo Co.,Ltd. engages in the development of information processing systems and provision of related services in Japan. It operates through Solution Service Business, Development, System Operation/Service Business, and Support Service Business segments. The company offers SmartStage front series, a lineup of front-end business SaaS solutions; Tramil, a purchasing process management cloud; SmartStage, an IT service management solution; CREO-RPA, an internal control-compliant RPA service; CREO-OCR, a high-precision handwriting recognition using an AI-OCR engine; Smart Stage hyper digital platform; and BIZ PLATFORM, a business process management platform. It also provides ZeeM Cloud, a DX promotion framework; ZeeM HR and Payroll integrates HR management and payroll calculation; ZeeM human resources and payroll for educational institution; ZeeM labor and social insurance outsourcing service; ZeeM lease asset management; ZeeM accounting; and ZeeM fixed asset management. In addition, the company offers QuickBinder, a document management system; cloud business solutions, which include building cloud sites and infrastructure development, as well as planning, designing, and operating services; construction of core business systems; development services for local government; 2Media, a media content creator solution; Success Mark, supports business automation and artificial intelligence; cross media solution; and Veva HR evaluation systems and Yahoo! Safety confirmation services. Further, it provides contract system development; system development, maintenance, and operation; and help desk and technical support. The company was formerly known as Tokai Create CO., LTD. and changed its name to Creo Co.,Ltd. in April 1989. Creo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the construction machinery rental business in Japan and internationally. The company offers various construction machinery for special sites, expressways/railways/airports/harbors, industrial complexes and plants, and repair works, as well as equipment for events and exhibitions, such as tents, stages, monitors, temporary stands, etc.; and support from transporting to assembling/disassembling the equipment. It also leases construction equipment, industrial machinery, machines for factory equipment maintenance, lifting equipment, tools, tower cranes, mobile elevated work platforms, power generators, and survey instruments; provides transportation services, construction work support, consulting, community-based services, compulsory vehicle liability insurance, electrical engineering works, temporary electrical installations, parking lot management, and car rental services; and develops and rents wastewater treatment equipment and hardware. In addition, the company rents and sells shoring equipment, laser measurement devices, equipment for managing working environments in factories, devices supporting reduced energy usage, forklift trucks, and elevated work platforms; specialized vehicles, including battery electric and hybrid vehicles; designs and constructs hybrid trusses; and repairs and inspects crane trucks, specialized vehicles, forklift trucks, and other vehicles. The company was formerly known as Nishio Rent All Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2023. Nishio Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

ISB Corporation engages in the provision of embedded software development services for mobile, medical, and automotive applications in Japan. The company is involved in software development services; medical information systems, hospital system and medical device development; development of public systems for local governments and government agencies; business system development; integrates hardware and software to provide optimal embedded solutions. It also provides financial systems; infrastructure construction and operation design and maintenance services for cloud services; system operation services; and data center housing and hosting, as well as Al solutions. In addition, the company offers IT services, including system development, application development, and operation and maintenance; financial system and mobile system development; and consulting services. Further, it sells equipment associated with system and software development; and develops and sells access control systems and electric locks. ISB Corporation was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

AGORA Hospitality Group Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the lodging business in Japan. It operates through Accommodation Business and Other Investment Business segments. The company is involved in the planning, development, operation, and management of hotels and inns. It also engages in the rental of stores and parking lots; supply of hot spring water; real estate rental; real estate development of housing; operation of cemeteries; and securities investment activities. The company was formerly known as Tokai Kanko Co., Ltd. and changed its name to AGORA Hospitality Group Co., Ltd in April 2012. AGORA Hospitality Group Co., Ltd was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Japan Airport Terminal Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the management of passenger terminal buildings in Japan. It operates through three segments: Facilities Management, Merchandise Sales, and Food and Beverage. The company constructs, manages, and operates domestic passenger terminal buildings; rents offices, stores, and other facilities to airline companies and airport concessionaires; and operates and manages parking lots. In addition, it is involved in the merchandise sale at stores in domestic and international terminals, including stores in the lobby; travel insurance agency and hotel reservation services, as well as rental of halls and conference rooms. Further, the company engages in the sale of international and domestic travel, and transport and events tickets; and management and operation of Haneda Airport Wharf. Additionally, it is involved in the commissioned activities, including facility maintenance and management, duty-free shop operation, passenger services, etc.; wholesale of duty-free goods; and merchandise and commissioned sale. Furthermore, the company operates restaurants; and produces and sells in-flight meals. Japan Airport Terminal Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Imperial Hotel, Ltd. operates and manages hotels in Japan. The company manages the Imperial Hotel Tokyo, the Imperial Hotel Osaka, the Crest Hotel Kashiwa, the Imperial Hotel Kyoto, and the Kamikochi Imperial Hotel. Its hotels offer accommodation, dining, banquet, facilities, serviced apartment, and other facilities. The company was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

NCS&A Co., Ltd. provides various IT services in Japan. It offers system design, software development, package software customization; hardware maintenance services for computer equipment and system support services for corporate computer systems. The company also offers platform solutions, including visualization, business, and security solutions; migration, outsourcing, cloud, and AI tools and services; and geospatial information software, etc. In addition, it provides industry/task solutions for financial and medical services, public sector, manufacturing, distribution, hotel/restaurant, and nursing care, etc. Further, the company sells computer equipment and peripherals, and in-house developed package software. NCS&A Co., Ltd. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

The Royal Hotel, Limited operates hotels in Japan. The company operates hotels under the RIHGA Royal Hotel name in Osaka, Tokyo, Kyoto, Hiroshima, Kokura, Chugoku, Shikoku, Okinawa, and Kyushu Kagawa. It provides accommodation, catering, and rental spaces. The company was formerly known as Shin Osaka Hotel, Ltd. and changed its name to The Royal Hotel, Limited in 1973. The Royal Hotel, Limited was founded in 1932 and is based in Kita, Japan.

transcosmos inc. provides business outsourcing services in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Single Service, Domestic Affiliates, and Overseas Affiliates. The company offers business processing outsourcing services, such as selling, SCM, finance, and documentation; accounting, procurement, and human resources; construction support housing and housing equipment design; machine design, built-in development, and back-office for design and production; support desk, system operation and maintenance, IoT, and multi-device lifecycle; and offshore services. It also provides contact center, customer care, sales support, industry-specific call center, contact center technologies, and analytics services. In addition, the company offers digital marketing services that make use of Internet promotions, digital integration, integrated marketing, channel-integrated communication, marketing tool support, and social media services. Further, it provides e-commerce services, including various functions required for e-commerce, such as e-commerce consulting services, website launch services, service network, online merges with offline, marketing and CRM services, fulfillment services, and one-stop services. Additionally, the company offers analytics services, including customer research, big data analytics, direct marketing consulting, customer support consulting, and market research and analytics; and other DEC integrated marketing services. transcosmos inc. was founded in 1966 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Hotel Newgrand Co., Ltd. operates hotels in Japan. It operates through Hotel and Real Estate Leasing segments. The company offers accommodation and dining facilities, including weddings and banquets within the Hotel New Grand; and restaurants within the Takashimaya Yokohama and Sogo Yokohama stores. It also provides rental management services for office buildings and other properties. Hotel Newgrand Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Fujita Kanko Inc. engages in the tourism business in Japan and internationally. The company operates a portfolio of hotels, wedding and banquet venues, restaurants, and leisure facilities. It also provides supplementary services, such as hotel room cleaning, flower provision and arrangement, garden care and landscaping, and photography. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

The Kyoto Hotel, Ltd. operates accommodation, banquet, restaurant, and other facilitates in Japan. It operates hotels under the Karasuma Kyoto Hotel and Kyoto Hotel Okura names. The Kyoto Hotel, Ltd. was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

KNT-CT Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides travel related services in Japan. The company is involved in planning and sales of travel products, tours, and overseas group tours; media sales through newspaper advertisements; and the distribution of the information magazine Tabi no Tomo, as well as online sales. It also engages in consignment business; temporary staffing; trading and insurance businesses; outsourcing businesses; catalog advertising production businesses; wholesale of domestic and international group and individual travel and international airline tickets. In addition, it operates website YOKOS. JAPANTOUR. KNT-CT Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. KNT-CT Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Kintetsu Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.

TOKAI Corp. provides various healthy life services in Japan. It operates through Health and Life Services, Pharmacy Services, and Environmental Services segments. The company engages in hospital-related business that includes rental of hospital bedding and white coats, linen supply, nursing assistance, and in-hospital logistics management. It is also involved in the rental and sale of nursing care products and home renovation services under the nursing care insurance system; operation of MIC Health Forest day service facility for the rehabilitation for the elderly; development and manufacture finishing process machinery and equipment for dry cleaning factories; provision of meal services comprising regular and therapeutic meals; and water delivery business under the Aqua Clara brand. In addition, the company engages in the operation of Tanpopo Pharmacy specialty dispensing pharmacy and Drugmic drugstore chain; rental of environmental beautification products under the Leaskin brand; cleaning and management of hospital and other buildings; and solar business. Further, it is involved in the production of business reports, individual surveys, brochure creation, and booklets, as well as the operation of business information. Additionally, it serves medical institutions and nursing care facilities. TOKAI Corp. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.

Hakuyosha Company, Ltd. engages in the cleaning, rental, real estate, and other businesses in Japan. It provides a range of products for home clothing care, including detergents and fabric softeners that are used in home washing machines, as well as insect repellents and clothes covers. The company also rents various linen items, including sheets, towels, tablecloths, and napkins for hotel and restaurant operations, as well as uniforms; and engages in the rental and management of real estate properties. In addition, it offers bedding and interior cleaning services; cleaning and storage services for clothes, such as coats and jackets, as well as for household items comprising carpets and futons; pick-up and delivery cleaning, dry cleaning delivery, and house cleaning services; and used clothing purchase services. Further, the company operates Texcare, which offers maintenance and restoration services; and sells sell machines and materials for cleaning business. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.

SECOM CO., LTD., together with its subsidiaries, provides security services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Security Services, Fire Protection Services, Medical Services, Insurance Services, Geospatial Information Services, BPO and ICT Services, and Others segment. Its Security Services segment offers static guard, armored car, merchandise, and other services, as well as online security systems. The Fire Protection Services segment provides fire alarm systems, fire extinguishing systems, and maintenance services to office buildings, production facilities, tunnels, cultural properties, ships, and residences. Its Medical Services segment offers home medical services, including home nursing services and pharmaceutical dispensing services and home delivery services; operation of residences for seniors; sales of electronic medical report systems, medical equipment, and pharmaceutical products; personal care services, and the leasing of real estate for medical institutions. The Insurance Services Segment provides fire insurance, automobile insurance, and cancer treatment insurance services. Its Geospatial Information Services segment offers geospatial information services to national and local governments; private sector customers; and overseas government agencies. The BPO and ICT Services segment provides business continuity planning (BCP) support, information security services, cloud-based services and authentication services centering on the data centers, as well as BPO-related services including operation of contact center services. Its Other Services segment offers real estate leasing, construction, and installation services. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

NSW Inc. operates as an enterprise, services, embedded, and device solutions provider in Japan. It provides business solutions, such as consulting, system design, development, maintenance, and operation solutions for manufacturing, distribution, finance, insurance, and government sectors. The company also offers IT services, including servers and networks designing; secure environment development; and operating and monitoring systems, as well as IoT & AI services. In addition, it is involved in the embedded system development business, which include development of applications, middleware, and drivers for automotive and industrial sectors; and edge device solutions. Further, it develops LSI and FPGA for image processing and communication control fields. The company was formerly known as Nippon Systemware Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NSW Inc. in June 2022. NSW Inc. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd. provides security services in Japan. The company operates through Security Business, and Building Management and Real Estate Business segments. The company offers on-site security, including facility security, fire and disaster prevention safety management, and VIP personal protection services; mechanical security, such as online and home security; and transport security consisting of security, escort and transportation services for cash, valuables, etc., as well as sells non-life insurance products linked to mechanical security contracts. It also sells and installs surveillance cameras and image monitoring systems; access control systems; and installation and sales of security, fire prevention, and disaster prevention equipment and facilities. Further, the company provides image analysis VACS system, image browsing system, SecurityPlatform ladder, CSP security robot, drone services, Biz Guard S and Biz Guard Revo office security, access control system centrics, apartment security safe room, NEW HiSCT total apartment security, intercom renewal service, unmanned reception system for apartment buildings, AED, safety confirmation service, CSP life support mail, camera malfunctioning monitoring, transport security, comprehensive building management, insurance, mobile emergency reporting system, cyber-attack countermeasures, pest repellent device, and fire hose reel. It also engages in real estate leasing services. It serves hotel, sports gym, coworking spaces, unmanned stores, logistics facilities, small office, building, nursery schools and kindergartens, clinic, restaurant, station, railway depots and substations, apartment, urban commercial facilities, suburban commercial facilities, stadium, factory, and shrines and temples. Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

INES Corporation provides information network system services to industrial corporations, financial institutions, and public entities in Japan. It also offers operation and maintenance services for information systems and communication networks, including IT outsourcing and iDC services for the operation and maintenance of systems; and information system analysis and design, program development, testing, and conversion services, such as software development for the financial, distribution, and service industries, as well as for the public sector. In addition, the company provides system integration services for software and hardware systems comprising the construction of web-based networks, client/server networks, local area networks, and wide-area networks; and sale of mobile PCs, automatic printing device systems, and other equipment. Further, it offers other system-related services, including data input, help desk, and security services, as well as machine-room, and network operation and management, systems maintenance, and training in PC systems; and hardware procurement, staff training and education, ERP consulting, and outsourcing services. The company was formerly known as Kyoei Computer Center and changed its name to INES Corporation in August 1984. INES Corporation was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

TKC Corporation operates as a specialized electronic data processing center for accounting firms and local governments in Japan. It operates through Accounting Firm Business, Local Government Business, and Printing Business segments. It is involved in the provision of information processing, software, and consulting services, as well as desk services; and sale of office equipment and supplies. It also provides printed continuous business forms; manufactures office supplies; development and sale of software; publishes books and monthly magazines on business management, taxation, and accounting; and provides security, maintenance, and repair services for buildings. In addition, the company manufactures and sells general office forms; and provides data printing services. The company was formerly known as Tochigi Prefecture Computing Center Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TKC Corporation in December 1986. TKC Corporation was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.

IX Knowledge Incorporated provides information technology services in Japan. The company offers IT strategy planning consulting, IT promotion consulting, and BI construction solutions; system development and no-code/low-code development support; system construction, system operation, and outsourcing services; and system verification. It also provides iMPLEO comprehensive quality solution services, including third party verification, system development support, and manual production services; AWS construction and operation support services; RPA/BPR solutions, such as WinActor, Biz Integral, and intra-mart; and Ocean to Table, a seafood traceability service that uses blockchain technology. In addition, the company is involved in civil engineering and of related software development activities; and information system consulting and software development, as well as sales and maintenance. IX Knowledge Incorporated was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

OYO Corporation provides geological survey services in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Disaster Prevention and Infrastructure, Environment and Energy, and International. The Disaster Prevention and Infrastructure engages in surveying and restoration design of areas damaged by natural disasters; forecasting damage, such as earthquakes, tsunamis, fires, etc. related to national and local governments disaster prevention plans; consulting on natural disaster risk surveys, loss forecasting, and countermeasures related to corporate business continuity plans; and building, installing, and updating monitoring systems related to natural disasters, including seismometer networks and volcano monitoring systems. This segment also offers inspection, diagnosis, and maintenance services for social infrastructure; survey, design, and measurement services for the development of resilient infrastructure; develops, sells, constructs, installs, and renews non-destructive testing products used for inspections and diagnoses; and constructs, installs, and renews environmental monitoring systems. The Environment and Energy segment provides consulting on surveys and countermeasures focusing on soil and groundwater contamination, asbestos, waste, etc.; surveys and consulting for global warming countermeasures and biodiversity conservation; geological survey consulting related to the construction, installation, and renewal of environmental monitoring systems; methane hydrate development research; support for the commercialization of renewable energy; Undersea3D resource exploration services; and develops and sells resource exploration equipment and systems. The International segment develops, manufactures, and sells non-destructive testing equipment and seismic observation systems, geophysical exploration equipment; and offers survey, design, and construction management services. OYO Corporation was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated provides consulting services for various industries in Japan. It offers logistics services, including consulting, trading, and transportation; management consulting, marketing and executive training, financial advisory, and digital marketing services; and digital solutions. The company was formerly known as Funai Consulting Incorporated and changed its name to Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

NSD Co., Ltd. provides various IT solutions in Japan. The company plans, designs, and develops systems; constructs IT infrastructure; and offers IT-utilized and IT consulting services. It also provides IT infrastructure services, including planning and procurement services comprising consulting and IT infrastructure sales support; design, development, and installation services, such as cloud, platform, network, storage, virtualization infrastructure, and security infrastructure design and development support services, as well as application development support services; and operation and maintenance services, such as system operation management and maintenance, system operation, lifecycle management, and helpdesk services. In addition, the company offers all-purpose software and duty-specific software products, and software development services. It serves finance, manufacturing, commerce, construction/real estate, service, transportation, telecommunication, and utilities industries. NSD Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Tokai Lease Co.,Ltd. manufactures, sells, and leases temporary buildings, modular houses, and related equipment in Japan. It offers flat houses, including convenience stores, nursery schools, support centers, factories, post offices, fire and disaster management agencies, emergency temporary housings, government buildings, police boxes, dining rooms, offices, and toilet buildings; unit houses comprising schools, vote counting facilities, and offices; and office equipment and fixtures, such as desk chairs, storage furniture, printers, air conditioners, multifunction printers, home appliances, outdoor and educational equipment, and others, as well as equipment for educational facilities. The company also provides TU suspended ceiling and partition, steel baseboard, kitchen capsule, Tokai system foundation, steel canopy and waist, steel steps, and air conditioner panels. In addition, it engages in temporary building construction, design, and supervision activities. Tokai Lease Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

Maruken Lease Co., Ltd. leases, sells, repairs, and fabricates temporary steel construction materials in Japan. The company provides sheet piles, H-beams, steel supports, steel decks, steel plates, etc. for foundation construction work. It installs and extracts piles; and undertakes earth retainment and underground continuous wall work. The company also engages in the construction and obstacle removal work comprising general civil engineering, scaffolding and earthworks, stonework, steel structure construction, paving, dredging, painting, interior finish work, thermal insulation, dismantling and water facility works. The company was formerly known as Marubeni Construction Material Lease Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Maruken Lease Co., Ltd. in October 2025. Maruken Lease Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Ohba Co., Ltd. provides consulting services for city planning projects in Japan. The company offers consulting services for the planning of cities, as well as technical support services to landowners in relation to land use and land use conversion. It is involved in the planning and design of roads, waterways, bridges, and water supply and sewage systems; and provision of technical services for creating social infrastructure. In addition, the company offers consulting services related to environmental research and assessments; and handles surveys and investigations involving geography and terrain. Further, it provides land and infrastructure maintenance and management services; and consulting services related to the disposal of real estate, as well as handles land, and drill boring and soil contamination investigations. Additionally, the company offers proposals involving geographic information and other related systems related to urban planning, civil engineering, environmental investigation, and preparation of spatial information. It provides consulting services related to inheritance tax and real estate utilization, as well as proposes solutions for addressing various social issues. Ohba Co., Ltd. was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Konami Group Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, primarily engages in the digital entertainment, arcade, gaming and systems, and sports businesses in Japan, Asia/Oceania countries, the United States, and Europe. The Digital Entertainment segment engages in the production, manufacture, and sale of digital content and related products, including mobile games, card games, and computer and video games. Its Amusement segment engages in the business planning, design, production, and sale of arcade games; and offers online game services. The Gaming & Systems segment produces, manufactures, sells, and services gaming machines and casino management systems. Its Sports segment operates sports facilities and sports courses, including swimming, gymnastics, dance, soccer, tennis, and golf, as well as produces and sells sports-related goods. The company was formerly known as Konami Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Konami Group Corporation in July 2022. Konami Group Corporation was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nikken Kogaku Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells wave-absorbing and foot-stabilizing products in Japan. The company offers wave dissipating, coastal revetment blocks, and other civil engineering products. It also provides coastal protection blocks, and riverbank disaster-prevention and environment protection blocks. In addition, the company offers natural stones and geosynthetics products. It serves land, infrastructure, transport, tourism, as well as government, and construction consultants and companies. Nikken Kogaku Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

IDEA Consultants,Inc. provides integrated consultancy services on social infrastructure development and environmental conservation projects in Japan and internationally. The company offers research, planning, designing, managing, evaluating, and consulting services related to construction and environmental conservation and improvement; environment work related services, such as surveys, forecasts, analysis, impact assessments, and environmental conservation measures; and physical and chemical analysis, and testing of water quality, air quality, soil, waste, tap water, food, etc. It also manufactures, sells, and leases environmental research and analysis equipment; provides industrial and domestic waste recycling, building and structure design and management, and civil engineering and construction work services; and engages in surveying and geological surveys, as well as real estate acquisition, sales, leasing, brokerage, maintenance, and management services. In addition, the company purchases and sales machinery, equipment, parts, and tools; provides staffing services; and produces and sells honey, royal jelly, pollen, etc. Further, the company offers environmental consulting services, including environmental assessment/environmental planning, conservation, restoration, and creation of the natural environment, environmental survey, chemical analysis and risk assessment, life science, and sustainability management support; construction consulting services comprising land conservation, transportation/logistics infrastructure, urban and regional development, and disaster response and recovery/reconstruction; and information system, such as disaster prevention/environment/construction system development, system operation support, meteorology, disaster prevention, and life information service, as well as infrastructure management services. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Setagaya, Japan.

DMS Inc. engages in direct mail service business in Japan. It offers direct marketing services, including planning and production, direct mail target optimization, mailing, personalized direct mail, and delivery services; web marketing services, such as Website and mobile site development; and logistics services, which includes shipping service for E-commerce and mail order businesses, gift campaign logistics services, and logistics for sales promotion support. The company also provides back-office support services, such as call center, data entry, telephone communication services, and other back-office solutions. In addition, it offers sales promotion solutions comprising POP display, poster, and vertical banner advertisement creation; promotional item creation; flyer delivery services; sample product delivery services; and niche media covering enclosed advertisements, etc. Further, the company is involved in planning, producing, creating, and managing sales promotion, sports and cultural, and campus events, as well as leasing services. It also designs planning, performance, production and operations for sporting events, local government projects, exhibitions, fireworks shows, ceremonies and contests, and school events. DMS Inc. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nac Co., Ltd. engages in rental and sale of dust control products in Japan. It operates through Kurikura Business, Rental Business, Architectural Consulting Business, Housing Business, and Beauty and Health Business segments. The Kurikura business segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of home delivery water, purified water servers, and hypochlorous acid solutions. The Rental Business segment engages in the rental and sales of dust control products, nursing care products, and welfare equipment, as well as pest control devices, regular cleaning services, and restoration work. The Architectural consulting business segment sells and constructs construction-related know-how products and construction materials to local builders, consulting services, and housing franchise business.The Housing Business is involved in the construction contracting for custom-built detached houses; sales of condominiums; and related financial services. The Beauty and Health Business segment manufactures and sells cosmetics, health food, beauty materials, and pharmaceuticals. It also offers financial services related to custom-built detached houses; import and sale of alcoholic beverages and Korean food products. The company was formerly known as Duskin Tsurugawa Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nac Co., Ltd. in 1977. Nac Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Fukui Computer Holdings,Inc. develops and sells package CAD products for the construction industry in Japan. The company offers ARCHITREND Zero, a 3D architectural CAD system for design works; ARCHITREND ONE, a design connect service; ARCHITREND VR, a virtual space experience system; Madoritch, a floor plan creation app; Rinobechi, a survey app that links data with 3D architectural CAD; Modelio, a housing presentation software; ARCHITREND Housing Lot Sales Simulation; ARCHITREND Reform Palette, a renovation photo simulator; TREND photo management, a software that imports, edits, and layouts construction photos; 3D Catalog.com, a 3D simulation site for building materials/equipment and housing; GLOOBE, a BIM architectural design and construction support system; and TREND-ONE and Mercury-ONE, a surveying CAD system, as well as DandALL, an application that manages the delivery and lifting of materials and equipment at construction sites; and ARCHI Box, allows uploading blueprints, perspective drawings, proposal videos, etc. It also provides EX-TREND Musashi, a civil engineering construction management system for contractor and the civil engineering construction companies; FIELD-TERRACE, an on-site measurement app; TREND-POINT, a 3D point cloud processing system; and One Click Counter, an election exit poll system; and Phototraction, which develops and provides construction production support services, as well as customer support services. In addition, the company offers ONE CLICK Counter, an election exit poll system; and picta, a vote forwarding system. The company was formerly known as Fukui Computer, Inc. and changed its name to Fukui Computer Holdings,Inc. in July 2012. Fukui Computer Holdings,Inc. was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Fukui, Japan.

Biken Techno Corporation provides general building maintenance services in Japan. The company offers cleaning and equipment management, security services, engineering, and hygiene management; leasing management, tenant management, construction management, total maintenance, and accounting; and cleaning and sterilization services. It also offers Renovation and renewal work, repair work, and renewal construction; building management, maintenance, and building optimization; reception/call center services; quality control team services; designated manager system; and PFI/market test services. In addition, the company operates various franchise businesses, such as Mister Donut fast food shop, Tsutaya video rental shop, Pronto café and bar, and Salvatore Cuomo Italian restaurant. Further, it offers long-term care services that include visiting nursing, home help, and home care support services, as well as medical management consulting services; and manages nursing homes and nursery. Additionally, the company is involved in management of hotel; and Senior Life Business. Biken Techno Corporation was incorproated in 1963 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Daiseki Co.,Ltd. engages in the industrial waste treatment and resource recycling activities in Japan. The company engages in research and restoration of polluted soil; recycling of waste plasterboard; washing and treatment of tanks; treatment of general waste; recycling of waste plastic; recycling of used automotive and industrial batteries; refining of lead; collection and recycling of used paper; and refining the lubricating oil, as well as selling the petrol products. It is also involved in disasters and accidents engineering works; cleaning of machinery and equipment; transformer oil/hydraulic oil replacement work; soil remediation work; recycling into heavy oil; conversion of supplemental fuels; and sludge treatment and recycling activity. In addition, the company offers concrete release agent panerol; secondary concrete and concrete pier construction products; industrial lubricating oils; and rust inhibitors spray. Daiseki Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Asahi Intelligence Service Co., Ltd. provides information processing services in Japan. The company is also involved in the construction, operation, and management of LAN/WAN products, and various Windows/UNIX servers; and provision of system integration and system operation management. In addition, it offers software maintenance, operation construction support, and system operation improvement; and maintains, operates, and manages host computer systems; office automation support; and installs software and provides information services, such as help desk. Asahi Intelligence Service Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

T.O. Holdings CO.,LTD., through its subsidiaries, engages in the distribution of clothing, furniture, home appliances, household appliances, mobile phone agency, and credit card business in Japan and internationally. It also offers consumer loans; sells DIY supplies and food products; DVD / CD rentals, books/magazines, etc.; and timber, building materials. In addition, the company is involved in the civil engineering, pavement, and construction works, such as buildings and commercial facilities; leasing business of land and buildings, comprises detached houses, offices, warehouses, etc.; automobile sales and automobile repair business; and operation of sports clubs and swimming schools. Further, it engages in the provision of fire and automobile insurance, non-life insurance agency business, life insurance business, and leasing business, as well as sell and lease office equipment, such as printers and multifunction devices, and mail order sales of office supplies and field supplies. Additionally, the company provides consultation services on new car sales, used car handling, inspection, maintenance, catalogs, quotes, test drive searches services, and car insurance consultations. The company was formerly known as T.O. Ogasawara Co., Ltd. and changed its name to T.O. Holdings Co.,Ltd. in June 2017. T.O. Holdings CO.,LTD. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Hakodate, Japan.

Striders Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate, hotel, investment, and other businesses primarily in Japan. It develops and sells vehicle management systems to support logistics operations. The company also offers residence, building management, rental brokerage, real estate sales, rent guarantee, interior design, hotel ownership and management, corporate restructuring and reorganization business, property and leasing management, business investment and group management. In addition, it provides advisory and consultancy services for mergers and acquisitions; online short-term home rental marketplace; healthcare, retail, and financial services; operates a platform to digitize smallholder farmers; restructuring, and fund-raising support services. Further, the company owns and operates the Narita Gateway Hotel in the Narita Airport Area and Kurashiki Royal Art Hotel. Striders Corporation was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

MT Genex Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in renovation of office buildings and real estate management in Japan. It operates through four segments: Renewal, Parking Lots, Facility Maintenance and Management, and Insurance Agency. The company is involved in operation and management of parking lots and bicycle parking facilities; construction work, including restoration work, interior work, and overall building repair and renovation projects; and building management, property management services, supply of toilet paper and other supply services, fire safety inspection and reporting services, disaster prevention management inspection and reporting services, and vending machine operation and management. The company also offers real estate development, hotel management, and investment business; and non-life insurance agency business. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan. MT Genex Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Mori Trust Co., Ltd.

Mammy Mart Holdings Corporation operates a chain of supermarkets in Japan. Its supermarket primarily sells fresh produce. Mammy Mart Holdings Corporation was formerly known as Mammy Mart Corporation and changed to Mammy Mart Holdings Corporation in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

Senshu Electric Co.,Ltd. trades in various electric wires, cables, and materials related to electrical construction work in Japan. The company also engages in the development, trading, and consulting of data processing and communication systems; manufactures and sells electronic controlled appliances and equipment; and installs and sells air conditioning appliances, home electrical appliances, and office equipment. In addition, it is involved in the power generation business; buying and selling of electric power; and lease of real estate. Senshu Electric Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.

Genki Global Dining Concepts Corporation engages in the restaurant-related businesses in Japan and internationally. It also operates sushi restaurants under the Uobei, Genki Sushi, and Senryo brands, as well as GINZA SEN-RYO brand sushi and dining bar and Umakatsu restaurant brand. The company was formerly known as Genki Sushi Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Genki Global Dining Concepts Corporation in July 2024. Genki Global Dining Concepts Corporation was founded in 1968 and is based in Taito, Japan.

Yamada Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the consumer electronics retailing activities in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Consumer Electronics, Housing, Financial, and Environment Business. The company offers home electrical appliances, such as Televisions, refrigerators, and washing machines; home information appliances, including computers and mobile phones; housing-related products comprises furniture and home interiors provision of renovation services. It is also involved in manufacturing and sale of housing equipment, such as bathroom equipment and kitchen equipment; and providing reuse, recycling, and recovery of resource services mainly for home electrical appliances and computers, as well as provides financial products for new construction, renovation, payment services, insurance products, and life planning. The company was formerly known as Yamada Denki Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yamada Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2020. Yamada Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Takasaki, Japan.

Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates a chain of retail stores for automotive goods and services in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: AUTOBACS Business; Consumer Business; Wholesale Business; and Expansion Business. The AUTOBACS Business segment engages in the wholesale of car accessories, such as tires, wheels, and car electronics to franchisees. The Consumer Business segment sells car accessories through physical stores, websites, and official apps, as well as offers installation, vehicle maintenance, and vehicle inspections services, and bodywork services; and purchases and sells vehicles. The Wholesale Business segment engages in the wholesaling of lifestyle brands and other private brands, etc. The Expansion Business segment engages in credit-related businesses, insurance agencies, as well as provides financing, property and location development, and motorized bicycles. The company was formerly known as Fuji-Syokai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd. in March 1980. Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Juntendo Co.,Ltd. operates home improvement stores in Japan. The company's home centers offer products for agriculture, gardening, materials, hardware, tools, and workwear, as well as DIY, pets, and outdoor activities. It also supplies goods during disasters. Juntendo Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1894 and is headquartered in Masuda, Japan.

Morito Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of apparel-related materials and household goods and products in Japan, Asia, Europe, and the United States. It provides eyelets, snap fasteners, buckles, tape, and shoe uppers, casual wear, sportswear, formal wear, and uniforms. The company also offers stationery and office automation equipment. In addition, it is involved in import, sale, and wholesale of marine and leisure equipment, snowboards, and the rental, sale, and cleaning of kitchen equipment; and transportation business. The company was formerly known as Morito & Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Morito Co., Ltd. in 1976. Morito Co., Ltd. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Arclands Corporation engages in the retail business in Japan. The company operates home centers under the HOME CENTER MUSASHI and VIVA HOME name; pro shop under the MUSASHI PRO and VIVA HOME PRO name; supermarket under the MUSASHI Food Hall name; pet shop under the NICO PET name; and art and craft business under the ARK OASIS and VC'S name. It also involved in the food service business under the Katsuya and Karayama brand name; wholesale under the ARCLAND SAKAMOTO; home renovation under the ARC HOME name; fitness business under the JOYFIT and FIT365; e-commerce business under the ARCLANDS Online, VIVA HOME Online, ARC OASIS Online, and Dog House Hall names; and real estate business, such as store development and tenant contracts. The company was formerly known as Arcland Sakamoto Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Arclands Corporation in September 2022. Arclands Corporation was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Sanjo, Japan.

Nitori Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in sales furniture and interior goods in Japan. It is involved in advertising and public relations support; logistics; and other activities. The company engages in insurance agency and clothing related, as well as information system and digital base businesses. Nitori Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Parker Corporation operates through machinery, chemicals, industrial material, engineering business in Japan, China, Asia, the United States, and Europe. The company manufactures and sells food processing machinery, shoemaking machinery, automotive-related equipment, and other machinery; sealing materials, undercoats, hollow and foamed materials for automotive manufacturing lines, materials for vehicle; foamed glass sealing materials, and other products; soundproofing materials for automobiles and home appliances, etc. It also handles industrial cleaning agents and steelwork materials; cleaning agents, steel equipment and machinery, etc. In addition, the company manufactures and sells fine chemicals for the electronics industry, and car care chemicals; industrial hot air blower desiccants, and other related products. It serves automobiles, electrical equipment, chemicals, steel, electronics, and food industries. The company was formerly known as Parker Shoji Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Parker Corporation in August 1988. Parker Corporation was incorporated in 1951 and is based in Chuo, Japan.

Tenmaya Store Co., Ltd. operates a chain of retail stores in Japan. It operates in two segments, Retail Business and Retail-Related Business. The company is also involved in the retail sales of food, miscellaneous goods, and clothing; manufacturing and sales of prepared food; restaurant business; and provision of store rental and other related businesses. Tenmaya Store Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

Gourmet Kineya Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of restaurants. The company operates through Restaurant Business, ODM/OEM Business, Real Estate Leasing Business, and Transportation Business segments. It also offers in-flight meals; operates wholesale market and engages in real estate rental business; operates railway services and road passenger transport services. The company is also involved in wholesale of fresh seafood and processed seafood products and rice; commercial frozen food manufacturing; selling grains, processing and cooking food, and food products; manufactures and supplies ready-to-eat food. In addition, it offers food under Udon, Buckwheat, Western, Japanese, Asia and other region categories. The company was formerly known as Ryogoku Foods Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Gourmet Kineya Co.,Ltd. in September 1986. Gourmet Kineya Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Ginza Renoir Co., Ltd. engages in the cafes and coffee shop business in Japan. It also manufactures, processes, and sells food products; manages franchise stores and technical guidance; and manages restaurants. The company operates coffee and bakery shops under the Cafe Renoir, Miyama Coffee, NEW YORKER'S Café, BAKERY HINATA, and Aline café and sucreries names. It also provides My Space for meeting rooms; and My Booth for personal space. Ginza Renoir Co., Ltd. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Nakano, Japan.

Aigan Co.,Ltd. develops and operates existing stores and provide solution a chain of eyeglasses specialty stores in Japan. The company offers eyeglasses, hearing aids, sunglasses, and other related products. Aigan Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Ku Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates as a dealer of new and used cars in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Domestic Car Sales Business and Imported Car Dealership Business. It engages in used car sales, new car sales, after-sales service, vehicle repair, and insurance agency services for all domestic car manufacturers, as well as handles European and American car brands. Ku Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Machida, Japan.

Eiwa Corporation offers industrial measurement, and control equipment, environmental measurement and analysis equipment, measurement and inspection equipment, industrial machinery in Japan. It offers industrial instruments, such as level, pressure, temperature and humidity, load, rotation, torque, current, voltage, power measurement equipment, and flow rate measurement, as well as temperature measurement; and control equipment, including factory automation sensors, information and communication devices, control system equipment, and receiving device. The company also provides environmental measurement and analysis equipment; pumps, valves, hydraulic and pneumatic equipment; and pressure measurement, inspection equipment and material measurement, and non-destructive testing equipment. In addition, it offers industrial equipment, including security equipment, environmental improvement equipment, manufacturing equipment, energy, and waste disposal/recycled equipment; and Industrial vehicles. Further, the company provides focused solutions, such as digital transformation, green transformation, and social infrastructure development. It serves petrochemical/functional materials, steel, non-ferrous metals, electric power, shipbuilding, car industries, as well as local governments and government agencies. The company was formerly known as Eiwa Seiko Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Eiwa Corporation in 1987. Eiwa Corporation was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Yoshinoya Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, owns and operates restaurants in Japan and internationally. It also involved in management of beef bowl and other fast food restaurants and management advisory for franchised stores; self-service sanuki-style udon noodle; and business investment, fund management and franchisee recruitment. Yoshinoya Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Solekia Limited handles electronic devices, semiconductors, component/device solutions, system integration, and other IT solutions in Japan and internationally. The company sells semiconductor and component products, embedded devices, monitors, and storage equipment. It also engages in software development, system integration, and network solution services, as well as consulting, construction, operation, and maintenance; and IT infrastructure design, construction, system monitoring, help desk, BCP drafting, and disaster recovery program. In addition, the company is involved in the IT Solution business activities such as ERP, BCP, environment, and energy-saving, corresponding to the needs of government municipal offices and local government authorities, manufacturing, distribution, agricultural cooperatives, consumers' cooperative association, financial operations, and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Kobayashi Denshi Sangyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Solekia Limited in April 2002. Solekia Limited was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Kato Sangyo Co., Ltd. engages in the general food wholesaling business in Japan and internationally. Its products include ambient temperature processed foods, frozen/chilled foods, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, etc. The company also manufactures and sells food products, including jam spreads, peanut butter whip, honey and syrup, canned fruit, fisheries, livestock, and agricultural canned food, ANKO products, chestnut nectar stew, nori, dry, powder, noodles, pasta related, instant and convenient products, condiment, cooking oil, drink, pastry, and gift products. In addition, it offers retail support and logistics solutions. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Nishinomiya, Japan.

Kitakei Co., Ltd. engages in the sale and installation of new building materials, housing equipment, and other products in Japan. It provides wooden building materials, including interiors doors, closets, floors, system storage, and staircase sets; non-wood building materials, such as gypsum board, insulation, roofing materials, non-combustible board, and siding products; and Lauan and softwood plywood products. The company also offers wood products comprising wood structural and construction materials, flooring, and laminated boards; housing equipment, including system kitchen, unit bath, vanities, toilet, air conditioning equipment, combustion equipment, and solar panels; and other products, such as sashes, exteriors, chemical products, and architectural hardware and tools. In addition, it is involved in the construction of exterior walls, housing, roof, structural frame, interior, and sash; and solar power generation system, as well as provision of ancillary services. The company offers its products to lumber stores, building material stores, construction companies, housing companies, etc. Kitakei Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Cox Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiary, engages in planning, manufacturing, and sales of clothing and miscellaneous goods in Japan. It offers men's, women's, and children clothing under the Ikka, LBC, VENCE EXCHANGE, TOKYO DESIGN CHANNEL BUYERS SELECT, Notch, NO NEED, and sleeping.com brand names. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Cox Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Aeon Co., Ltd.

SEKIDO Co., Ltd. operates fashion stores. It provides rings, necklaces, earrings, and other jewelry; wristwatches, wall clocks, smoking accessories; and handbags, wallets, belts, glasses. The company also engages in beauty business, offers sheet masks and packs, makeup, skin care products, and beauty equipment, etc. It offers cosmetics products under the MEDIHEAL brand; and sells fashion products through online shopping sites under the GINZALoveLove and &choa! brands. SEKIDO Co., Ltd. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Innotech Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the import and sale of electronic design automation software, electric components, and semiconductor products in Japan, China, and internationally. The company also develops and sells testers and CPU boards. It provides industrial boards/embedded systems, environmental boards/systems, EDA and OrCAD software, servers/storage solutions, noise analysis solutions, model-based development solutions, digital media analysis and inspection solutions, testers/probe cards, face recognition AI solution, and robot automation services. In addition, it is involved in the sale of quality verification software for media workflows; noise analysis; and model-based development consulting services. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Yellow Hat Ltd. is involved in the retail of car and motorcycle accessories. It operates through two segments, Sales of Automotive and Motorcycle Parts and Rental Real Estate. The company offers tires and wheels, oil, functional and car wash products, chemicals, audio visuals, and car interior and exterior products. Yellow Hat Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Matsuya Foods Holdings Co., Ltd. owns and operates restaurants in Japan, China, and Taiwan. The company operates beef-on-rice and set meals chains; and pork cutlet, sushi, and Chinese noodle restaurants, as well as provides restaurant technology and management instructions to franchise stores. It also engages in the kitchen equipment maintenance, construction supervision, water supply, drainage construction, and cleaning activities; and sale of sanitary detergents. In addition, the company engages in logistics business, and deliver food materials to factories and stores. The company was formerly known as Matsuya Foods Co., Ltd. Matsuya Foods Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Musashino, Japan.

UEX, Ltd. engages in the fabrication, distribution, and sale of stainless steel, titanium, and other metal products in Japan. It offers stainless steel plates, weather covers, strips, tubes, pipes, bars, and shapes; building materials; stainless steel for hydrogen stations; and duplex stainless steel, and processed products, as well as machinery and engineering products. The company also provides cutting services. The company was formerly known as Ueno Metalex, Ltd. and changed its name to UEX, Ltd. in 1998. The company was founded in 1872 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

JBCC Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) services in Japan. It operates through Information Solutions Business; and Product Development and Manufacturing Business segments. The Information Solutions segment provides building, operation, and maintenance services for corporate information systems focusing on ultra-high-speed development, cloud computing, and security, which are classified into system development (SI), services, and systems. The Product Development and Manufacturing segment develops and provides software and product management systems, including cloud linkage platforms; and manufactures and sells various hardware, such as printers. The company also provides staff service agency services; and IT utilization services comprising consulting, application and system development, monitoring, and outsourcing services. JBCC Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Makiya Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail business of household goods in Japan. It operates discount stores under the Espot name that offers outdoor, living room, alcoholic beverage, and fresh food products; cash and carry supermarkets; and community-based daily supermarkets under the POTATO name. It also operates hard off stores, which provide personal computers and AV equipment, as well as off house stores that offer furniture and household goods; and general store, which provide interiors and miscellaneous goods for adults. Makiya Co., Ltd. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Fuji, Japan.

Consec Corporation manufactures and sells drilling and cutting equipment in Japan and internationally. It offers hand, wall, and plunge cutter equipment, as well as wire saws and core drill products; automatic feeders, hydraulic units, hard transformers, optical fiber cable laying robots, road surface grinding machines, grooving cutters; and diamond core bits, blades, and wires under the Hakken brand name. The company also undertakes special contractor works; and sells construction machinery, housing and lifestyle related equipment, and OA equipment. In addition, it rents real estate facilities. Consec Corporation was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

JK Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale of decorative plywood, building materials, and housing equipment in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: General Building Materials Wholesale; General Building Materials Retail; and Plywood Manufacturing and Wood Processing. The company manufactures and sells ordinary, secondary, structural, and long plywood; plywood-based products; veneer; laminated veneer, timber, and lumber; laminated processed products; wood products; logs; building materials; and home appliances. It also provides structural design, supply of wooden structural frames, pre-cutting, construction, material supply for wooden interior, and installation. In addition, the company is involved in construction work; warehousing and transportation; general cargo; material brokerage; real estate rental; franchise business; travel and insurance agency; housing loan; and e-commerce and management. The company exports its products. JK Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in koto, Japan.

Sagami Holdings Corporation is engaged in the development of chains of Japanese and noodle restaurants in Japan, Vietnam, and Italy. It operates restaurants under the Sagami, Ajino Mingei, Don Don An, Aiso-Ya, CHOSUKE, NIDAIME CHOSUKE, SUIZAN, JINJIN, SAGAMI, BINMUGI, BUBUKA, Sagami Issha, SAGAMI VIETNAM, and SAGAMI Milano Centrale names. The company is also involved in the management of restaurants; manufactures, processes and sales of noodles; franchise business; management of overseas outlets; manages the Tenobe Udon specialty restaurant, Ajino-Mingei, and other specialty restaurant chains; manufacture, processes, sales, and import/export of ingredients, food and restaurant-related materials, cut vegetables, sauces and soups, and delicatessen; provision of sales support and business promotion services; and product development work. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

NICHIDEN Corporation operates as a trading company in Japan and internationally. The company offers transmissions, chain transmission, belt transmission, gear transmission, couplings, other transmission-related products, bearings, rings, LINEAR motion devices, bearing units, other bearing-related products, metal materials, synthetic materials, ceramics, and new materials. It also provides transport equipment, vibrators, lifting and hoisting equipment, storage-related equipment, transport systems, structural system equipment, packaging and packaging systems, other material handling, transportation-related products, environmental equipment, fans, dust collection and cleaning equipment, pumps, other machinery and tools. In addition, the company offers Hydraulic equipment, pneumatic equipment, vacuum equipment, hoses, tubes, joints, sequencers, displays, actuators, switches, encoders, image, processing, measuring equipment and instruments, panel equipment, robots, nut runners, mechatronics parts, piping, equipment, communication and network equipment, uninterruptible power supplies, and other control equipment related products. NICHIDEN Corporation was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kanseki Co., Ltd. engages in the retail business in Japan. The company manages and operates home improvement stores under the Home Center Kanseki brand name; outdoor life stores under the WILD-1 brand name; specialty stores under the Hard Off and Off House brand names; vegetable markets under the Rakuraku Market brand name; hamburger and pasta restaurants under the Wild Barn brand name; fitness gyms under the LifeFit brand name; and yakiniku restaurants under the Premium Karubi brand name. It is also involved in real estate rental management. The company was formerly known as Hattori Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kanseki Co., Ltd. in December 1976. Kanseki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.

Verite Co., Ltd. engages in the retail and wholesale of jewelry and other products in Japan. The company offers jewelry goods, jewels, gemstones, precious metals, watches, and fashion goods. It operates stores under the Vérité, Maharaja Diamond, Mimikazari, and Velicia brand names. The company was formerly known as Jewel Verite Ohkubo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Verite Co., Ltd. in August 2005. Verite Co., Ltd. was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan. Verite Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of SENKO Group Holdings Co., Ltd.

Fujii Sangyo Corporation engages in the sale of electrical construction materials, electrical equipment, machine tools, information equipment, and civil engineering and construction machinery in Japan. It operates through Material Innovations Company, Infrastructure Solutions Company, Komatsu Construction Equipment Sales and Service Japan, Ltd., and Others segments. The company distributes lighting fixtures, electric wires, power distribution boards, air conditioners, ventilation fans, wiring and electrical circuit equipment, EV charging equipment, communication and video equipment, audio equipment, solar power generation systems, and energy storage equipment; network equipment, surveillance and security equipment, assembly hall equipment, electronic medical records and nurse call systems, IP phone and CATV equipment; and construction and plant equipment. It also installs and sells exterior wall materials, roofing materials, foundation structural materials, and civil engineering materials; develops and sells information processing systems and software; computer equipment and office supplies; designs, constructs, and maintains information-related equipment; and designs and constructs industrial buildings. In addition, the company sells control and power distribution equipment, electronic equipment, semiconductors, environmental equipment, various production materials, industrial robots, various machine tools, machining centers, and press machines; designs and manufactures automatic control panels and automated equipment; and design, construction, maintenance, and security management services. Further, it engages in the provision of lighting design, energy conservation support, electrical equipment, and consulting; sale, maintenance, and rental of construction machinery; product repair and after-sale services; and solar power generation, including ground and roof installation. Fujii Sangyo Corporation was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.

Nihon Denkei Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale, repair, and calibration of electronic measuring instruments in Japan, China, and internationally. It offers electronic measuring instruments; science instruments and analysis equipment; environment, evaluation, and testing devices; information equipment and software products; manufacturing, processing, and inspection equipment; and optical, imaging, and precision devices. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

Nippo Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial materials and plastic molded product in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Electronics, Mobility, and Medical/Precision Equipment. The Electronics segment offers solid and liquid plastic materials, such as semiconductor sealants, polyimide plastic, heat-radiating plastic, and adhesives; functional films, which include dicing films, die attach films, anistropic conduction films, and temporary fastening tape; wiring board materials, consisting PCB materials, photosensitive dry films, and solder materials; oxygen and moisture free packaging materials; and jigs and tools equipment, such as inspection parts, wafer grinding carriers, vespel polyimide materials, teflon coatings, and various metal surface treatments. This segment also offers foamed thermal insulation for piping, plastic three-way valves, and joints, insulating materials, ion-exchange resins, assembled units, IC cards and tags, and radio frequency identification devices. The Medical/Precision Equipment segment offers disposable products, such as waste fluid bag and drug administration units; medical device components, including machined metal parts, processed plastic parts, surface treatments, cast and 3D formed products, and medical robot parts; printers and multifunction machines, consisting of molded plastic parts covers, gears, levers, and coatings, separator claws, stamped metal components, and precision components for printers, wristwatches, and instant cameras. The Mobility segment offers power train components, body system components, electrical system components, aluminum casting, machined metal parts, processed plastic parts, and surface treatments. It also operates contracted design, products for trucks, and products for plastic models. Nippo Ltd. was founded in 1940 and is based in Nagoya, Japan.

Uematsu Shokai Co.,Ltd., a trading company, purchases and sells machinery, tools and industrial machinery and equipment in Japan. The company offers metalworking machines, forging machines, automatic programming, can manufacturing, and steel frame machines; cutting, work, power tools, air tools, measuring tools and equipment, tooling equipment, etc.; and industrial machinery, such as prime movers, oil and pneumatic equipment, compressors, labor-saving and rationalization equipment, loading and unloading equipment, welding machines, pipework equipment, storage equipment, environmental improvement equipment, ME equipment, chemical products, construction machinery, etc. It also provides conduction equipment comprising bearings, transmissions, transmission parts, variable speed gears, etc.; and steel materials, office automation equipment, food-related equipment, home appliances, seasonal products, etc. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

Miroku Jyoho Service Co., Ltd. provides systems and solutions to tax accounting and CPA firms, and their client companies, and small/mid-sized companies in Japan. The company is involved in development of computer systems and application software; planning and development of industry-specific and process-specific application software; consulting from ERP deployment to development, operation and instructional guidance; and providing education and training, and support for business succession and revitalization for small enterprises.
